programme.desc: Fighting for survival at an isolated fishing outpost, Eva and her crew are cursed after making the choice to not help a sinking ship off the coast. Facing the consequences, a darkness consumes them all, creating chaos and death at every turn.

programme.title: Ick
programme.desc: Science teacher Hank's life changes when he reconnects with his first love and suspects a new student is his daughter, all while facing an alien threat in their town.

programme.title: The Craft
programme.desc: A new girl at an LA high school finds it difficult to make friends, and teams up with three fellow outcasts known as the Bitches of Eastwick. However, her telekinetic powers turn the supernatural games in which the three have been dabbling, into something much more sinister.

programme.title: The Bride!
programme.desc: In the 1930s Chicago, groundbreaking scientist Dr. Euphronious brings a murdered young woman back to life to be a companion for Frankenstein's monster. What happens next is beyond what either of them could ever have imagined.

programme.title: Final Destination Bloodlines
programme.desc: Plagued by a violent and recurring nightmare, a college student heads home to track down the one person who might be able to break the cycle of death and save her family from the grisly demise that inevitably awaits them all.

programme.title: Nosferatu
programme.desc: A new bride is left under the care of friends when her husband travels to Transylvania for a meeting with Count Orlok. Plagued by horrific visions and an increasing sense of dread, she soon encounters an evil force that's far beyond her control.

programme.title: 28 Years Later
programme.desc: Still living in quarantine due to the rage virus, a survivor decides to venture into the dark heart of the mainland. He soon discovers a mutation that has spread to not only the infected, but other survivors as well.

programme.title: Five Nights at Freddy's 2
programme.desc: When Mike's 11-year-old sister sneaks out to reconnect with Freddy, Bonnie, Chica and Foxy, she sets into motion a terrifying series of events that reveal dark secrets about the true origin of Freddy's.

programme.title: Shaun of the Dead
programme.desc: Shaun's humdrum existence takes a turn for the interesting when the undead take over London. Leaping into action, Shaun gathers his loved ones in the safest place he knows. Shaun, his mum and her boyfriend, his girlfriend, Liz, and his flatmates Ed and Pete fight off a fate worse than death from the local pub.

programme.desc: Bad dreams haunt 15-year-old Gwen as she receives calls from the black phone and sees disturbing visions of three boys being stalked at a winter camp. With help from her brother, she must now confront a killer who's grown even more powerful in death.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: A year after running over a fisherman and dumping his body in the water, four friends reconvene when Julie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) receives a frightening letter telling her that their crime was seen. While pursuing who he thinks is responsible for the letter, Barry (Ryan Phillippe) is run over by a man with a meat hook. The bloodletting only increases from there, as the killer with the hook continues to stalk Julie, Helen (Sarah Michelle Gellar) and Ray (Freddie Prinze Jr.).

programme.title: The Final Destination
programme.desc: While enjoying a day at the track, Nick O'Bannon (Bobby Campo) has a horrific premonition of his friends and him all dying in a freak accident involving many racecars. Mere seconds before the vision comes true, he manages to convince them to leave. Although they cheat death then, the survivors each begin to meet a grisly end, and Nick tries to figure a way to escape a similar fate.

programme.title: The Mist
programme.desc: After a powerful storm damages their Maine home, David Drayton (Thomas Jane) and his young son head into town to gather food and supplies. Soon afterward, a thick fog rolls in and engulfs the town, trapping the Draytons and others in the grocery store. Terror mounts as deadly creatures reveal themselves outside, but that may be nothing compared to the threat within, where a zealot (Marcia Gay Harden) calls for a sacrifice.

programme.title: Friday the 13th - Part III
programme.desc: The third installment in the "Friday the 13th" series picks up on the day after the carnage with homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees (Richard Brooker) stealing some clothes and killing a local store owner. Meanwhile, Chris (Dana Kimmell) and her sometimes boyfriend, Rick (Paul Kratka), are hosting a group of teenage friends at Chris' lake house. Despite a run-in with a local biker gang, they enjoy an amiable weekend together - that is, until Jason begins knocking off kids and bikers alike.

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: Crystal Lake's history of murder doesn't deter counselors from setting up a summer camp in the woodsy area. Superstitious locals warn against it, but the fresh-faced young people - Jack (Kevin Bacon), Alice (Adrienne King), Bill (Harry Crosby), Marcie (Jeannine Taylor) and Ned (Mark Nelson) - pay little heed to the old-timers. Then they find themselves stalked by a brutal killer. As they're slashed, shot and stabbed, the counselors struggle to stay alive against a merciless opponent.

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part 2
programme.desc: The second entry in the long-running horror series focuses on a group of teenage would-be counselors converging on Camp Crystal Lake for training under the tutelage of head counselor Paul (John Furey). Inevitably, Paul relates the story of Jason Voorhees (Warrington Gillette), a boy who ostensibly drowned at the camp and whose mother murdered a group of counselors in revenge. No one takes the tale seriously until a very much alive Jason begins gruesomely eliminating people.

programme.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
programme.desc: During a hallucinatory incident, young Kristen Parker (Patricia Arquette) has her wrists slashed by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). Her mother, mistaking the wounds for a suicide attempt, sends Kristen to a psychiatric ward, where she joins a group of similarly troubled teens. One of the doctors there is Nancy Thompson (Heather Langenkamp), who had battled Freddy some years before. Nancy senses a potential in Kristen to rid the world of Freddy once and for all.

programme.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 2: Freddy's Revenge
programme.desc: Jesse Walsh (Mark Patton) moves with his family into the home of the lone survivor from a series of attacks by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). There, Jesse is bedeviled by nightmares and inexplicably violent impulses. It turns out Freddy needs a host body to carry out his gruesome vendetta against the youth of Springwood, Ohio. While Freddy gains influence, Jesse and his girlfriend, Lisa (Kim Myers), race against the clock trying to figure out what's going on.

programme.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
programme.desc: In Wes Craven's classic slasher film, several Midwestern teenagers fall prey to Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), a disfigured midnight mangler who preys on the teenagers in their dreams - which, in turn, kills them in reality. After investigating the phenomenon, Nancy (Heather Langenkamp) begins to suspect that a dark secret kept by her and her friends' parents may be the key to unraveling the mystery, but can Nancy and her boyfriend Glen (Johnny Depp) solve the puzzle before it's too late?

programme.title: Freddy vs. Jason
programme.desc: Two horror icons face off in this supernatural movie. Disfigured serial killer Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), who attacks his victims in their dreams, has lost much of his power since citizens of his town have become less afraid of him. Enlisting the help of fellow violent murderer Jason Voorhees (Ken Kirzinger), Freddy orchestrates a new killing spree. However, when the hockey-mask-wearing psychopath won't stop chopping up Freddy's intended victims, the two ghouls start to battle each other.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: A year after running over a fisherman and dumping his body in the water, four friends reconvene when Julie (Jennifer Love Hewitt) receives a frightening letter telling her that their crime was seen. While pursuing who he thinks is responsible for the letter, Barry (Ryan Phillippe) is run over by a man with a meat hook. The bloodletting only increases from there, as the killer with the hook continues to stalk Julie, Helen (Sarah Michelle Gellar) and Ray (Freddie Prinze Jr.).

programme.title: The Final Destination
programme.desc: While enjoying a day at the track, Nick O'Bannon (Bobby Campo) has a horrific premonition of his friends and him all dying in a freak accident involving many racecars. Mere seconds before the vision comes true, he manages to convince them to leave. Although they cheat death then, the survivors each begin to meet a grisly end, and Nick tries to figure a way to escape a similar fate.

programme.title: The Mist
programme.desc: After a powerful storm damages their Maine home, David Drayton (Thomas Jane) and his young son head into town to gather food and supplies. Soon afterward, a thick fog rolls in and engulfs the town, trapping the Draytons and others in the grocery store. Terror mounts as deadly creatures reveal themselves outside, but that may be nothing compared to the threat within, where a zealot (Marcia Gay Harden) calls for a sacrifice.

programme.title: Friday the 13th - Part III
programme.desc: The third installment in the "Friday the 13th" series picks up on the day after the carnage with homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees (Richard Brooker) stealing some clothes and killing a local store owner. Meanwhile, Chris (Dana Kimmell) and her sometimes boyfriend, Rick (Paul Kratka), are hosting a group of teenage friends at Chris' lake house. Despite a run-in with a local biker gang, they enjoy an amiable weekend together -- that is, until Jason begins knocking off kids and bikers alike.

programme.title: Friday the 13th
programme.desc: Crystal Lake's history of murder doesn't deter counselors from setting up a summer camp in the woodsy area. Superstitious locals warn against it, but the fresh-faced young people -- Jack (Kevin Bacon), Alice (Adrienne King), Bill (Harry Crosby), Marcie (Jeannine Taylor) and Ned (Mark Nelson) -- pay little heed to the old-timers. Then they find themselves stalked by a brutal killer. As they're slashed, shot and stabbed, the counselors struggle to stay alive against a merciless opponent.

programme.title: Friday the 13th, Part 2
programme.desc: The second entry in the long-running horror series focuses on a group of teenage would-be counselors converging on Camp Crystal Lake for training under the tutelage of head counselor Paul (John Furey). Inevitably, Paul relates the story of Jason Voorhees (Warrington Gillette), a boy who ostensibly drowned at the camp and whose mother murdered a group of counselors in revenge. No one takes the tale seriously until a very much alive Jason begins gruesomely eliminating people.

programme.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
programme.desc: During a hallucinatory incident, young Kristen Parker (Patricia Arquette) has her wrists slashed by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). Her mother, mistaking the wounds for a suicide attempt, sends Kristen to a psychiatric ward, where she joins a group of similarly troubled teens. One of the doctors there is Nancy Thompson (Heather Langenkamp), who had battled Freddy some years before. Nancy senses a potential in Kristen to rid the world of Freddy once and for all.

programme.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street 2: Freddy's Revenge
programme.desc: Jesse Walsh (Mark Patton) moves with his family into the home of the lone survivor from a series of attacks by dream-stalking monster Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund). There, Jesse is bedeviled by nightmares and inexplicably violent impulses. It turns out Freddy needs a host body to carry out his gruesome vendetta against the youth of Springwood, Ohio. While Freddy gains influence, Jesse and his girlfriend, Lisa (Kim Myers), race against the clock trying to figure out what's going on.

programme.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
programme.desc: In Wes Craven's classic slasher film, several Midwestern teenagers fall prey to Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), a disfigured midnight mangler who preys on the teenagers in their dreams -- which, in turn, kills them in reality. After investigating the phenomenon, Nancy (Heather Langenkamp) begins to suspect that a dark secret kept by her and her friends' parents may be the key to unraveling the mystery, but can Nancy and her boyfriend Glen (Johnny Depp) solve the puzzle before it's too late?

programme.title: Freddy vs. Jason
programme.desc: Two horror icons face off in this supernatural movie. Disfigured serial killer Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), who attacks his victims in their dreams, has lost much of his power since citizens of his town have become less afraid of him. Enlisting the help of fellow violent murderer Jason Voorhees (Ken Kirzinger), Freddy orchestrates a new killing spree. However, when the hockey-mask-wearing psychopath won't stop chopping up Freddy's intended victims, the two ghouls start to battle each other.

programme.desc: On connaît leurs noms, mais peu les exploits de Jeanne Mance et Émilie Gamelin ; ces pionnières infatigables ont contribué à créer le premier filet social du Québec ; Valérie Plante suit leurs traces.

programme.title: Dis-moi pas!? La petite histoire des mots d'ici
programme.desc: Quelle est l'origine du mot chasse-galerie, qui évoque notamment une légende québécoise ; on découvre le lien entre des bûcherons qui traversent la nuit dans un canot d'écorce et des garnements qui courent comme des damnés sur une galerie.

programme.title: Bien bâti
programme.desc: Le Club sur la Bonaventure, en Gaspésie, est un témoin de l'histoire des camps de pêche du Québec ; le phare de l'île Verte rappelle l'époque de la navigation non automatisée ; et le patrimoine bâti vu en miniature par Marcel Arsenault.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Une étoile, c'est ni plus ni moins qu'une immense boule de gaz qui produit d'énormes quantités d'énergie sous forme de chaleur et de lumière. On estime que notre Soleil est âgé d'environ 4,6 milliards d'années et, comme toutes les étoiles, il a pris forme dans une nébuleuse et prendra fin lorsqu'il aura épuisé sa réserve d'énergie.

programme.title: Quatre saisons dans la vie de...
programme.desc: Ioan, entrepreneur en Montérégie, est né en Roumanie et est arrivé au Québec en 1994. Il a réinventé sa vie ici et s'est bâti un quotidien qui lui ressemble, tout en maintenant des liens étroits avec sa famille en Roumanie.

programme.title: Dis-moi pas!? La petite histoire des mots d'ici
programme.desc: Une équipe de hockey qui grafigne la glace, de mignons et diaboliques chatons qui grafignent les mains, des guitaristes jouant un rock qui grafigne ; les multiples sens du verbe grafigner révèlent ses origines surprenantes.

programme.title: De la scie au bistouri
programme.desc: On explore l'histoire de l'ophtalmologie, cette branche de la médecine qui se consacre aux maladies de l'œil, des techniques égyptiennes les plus précoces jusqu'aux puces électroniques du futur.

programme.title: L'architecture des possibles
programme.desc: De l'appartement salvateur de Katia Daraîche à un parc inclusif arraché à la bureaucratie, nous explorons des lieux où l'accessibilité devient une urgence concrète. Le quotidien en fauteuil ou avec une déficience visuelle est analysé avec précision, entre stationnements inadaptés, logements introuvables, trottoirs hostiles et solutions créatives. L'art y trouve aussi sa place, grâce à une salle de spectacle qui traduit la danse en gestes et en mots.

programme.title: Parlons job
programme.desc: Pendant des décennies, les problèmes de santé mentale au travail étaient tabous, jusqu'à ce que l'on constate les coûts faramineux qu'ils entraînaient.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Elle a révolutionné la compréhension du monde et la compréhension de l'humanité ; la théorie de l'évolution, développée par Charles Darwin au 19e siècle, fait encore jaser, même si ses fondements n'ont jamais été remis en question.

programme.title: Hélène reste en forme
programme.desc: La génétique est une pièce maîtresse du casse-tête que représente la forme physique. Comment ça fonctionne, les gènes ? Est-ce qu'on a des gènes de forme physique ? Y a-t-il des gènes spécifiques associés à l'endurance ou à la force musculaire ? Quelle est la part des gènes dans la forme physique d'un individu ?

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Sin, Cos, Tan : on explore ce que signifient ces étranges abréviations ; il s'agit de sinus, cosinus et tangente, trois rapports trigonométriques ; on découvre à quoi sert la trigonométrie.

programme.title: Louis T veut savoir
programme.desc: Lorsque Louis T apprend que mondialement près d'un.e adulte sur quatre est obèse, il cherche à savoir si ces personnes peuvent tout de même être en bonne santé ; il en discute avec des spécialistes de la question et suit Édith Bernier.

programme.title: Créatures microscopiques
programme.desc: Chloé s'intéresse aux êtres qui vivent sur le corps comme les petits acariens qui se cachent dans les pores de son visage ; elle observe aussi les cellules qui évoluent dans son sang et dans un échantillon de sperme.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: On appelle magnétosphère le champ magnétique qui entoure la Terre. Ce bouclier nous protège contre les bombardements d'énergie provenant du Soleil. C'est donc grâce à la magnétosphère que la vie sur Terre s'est développée. Et même si elle est invisible, on peut toutefois la voir à l'œuvre lors des aurores boréales.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Les sorties spatiales sont loin d'être des promenades de santé. À l'extérieur de la navette, les astronautes font face à un environnement hostile. Chaque sortie comporte des dangers. Il y a des risques de collision avec les débris qui flottent dans l'espace ou encore une fuite du système de ventilation de la combinaison. Et pourtant, la plupart des astronautes considèrent ces sorties dans l'espace comme une incroyable expérience.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Tout le monde connaît l'équation E = mc2, développée par Albert Einstein au début du 20e siècle ; on découvre ce qu'elle signifie et pourquoi elle est si importante.

programme.title: Shoah, je me souviens
programme.desc: Alors que les derniers survivants de l'Holocauste s'apprêtent à quitter ce monde, on s'interroge avec le psychiatre Patrick Bordeaux sur la manière dont on peut préserver et transmettre cette mémoire pour les générations futures.

programme.title: Étoile du Nord
programme.desc: De la place des femmes en astrophysique à la genèse du projet SIGNALS, Laurie et sa stagiaire Justine échangent sur le projet colossal dirigé par Laurie.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Les sorties spatiales sont loin d'être des promenades de santé. À l'extérieur de la navette, les astronautes font face à un environnement hostile. Chaque sortie comporte des dangers. Il y a des risques de collision avec les débris qui flottent dans l'espace ou encore une fuite du système de ventilation de la combinaison. Et pourtant, la plupart des astronautes considèrent ces sorties dans l'espace comme une incroyable expérience.

programme.title: Petits curieux, grands écrans
programme.desc: Les vidéos pour tout-petits promettent de favoriser leur développement, mais ces promesses sont sans fondement ; avant trois ans, les enfants ne comprennent pas vraiment ce qu'ils voient à l'écran et ne peuvent pas le transposer à la réalité.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: On perd le compte du nombre d'appareils électriques que l'on allume durant une journée ; à la base, on explore ce qu'est l'électricité et comment elle est produite.

programme.title: De la scie au bistouri
programme.desc: La dermatologie est une spécialité médicale qui veille sur le plus grand organe : la peau.

programme.title: Facteurs de risque
programme.desc: On visite le chantier de construction d'une école secondaire et on découvre les mesures et technologies adoptées pour réduire les risques encourus par les travailleurs ; puis, on expérimente une chute en bas d'une échelle.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Masse et poids ne sont pas des synonymes ; scientifiquement, ces concepts réfèrent à deux mesures distinctes, mais reliées ; la masse et le poids sont comme deux cousins de la même famille.

programme.title: Au bout des droits
programme.desc: Les parents de Marc, un adulte trisomique qui habite dans un appartement adapté à ses besoins ; pourquoi il est important de consulter un notaire régulièrement.

programme.title: Trouvez l'erreur
programme.desc: Il est facile de confondre les verbes apporter et emmener ; à retenir : on emmène une personne et on apporte un objet ; quand l'erreur se glisse dans les paroles d'une chanson, c'est encore plus flagrant.

programme.title: La course à l'or bleu
programme.desc: On se demande si on peut parvenir à sauver notre eau et notre avenir.

programme.title: Dis-moi pas!? La petite histoire des mots d'ici
programme.desc: Quelle est l'origine du mot chasse-galerie, qui évoque notamment une légende québécoise ; on découvre le lien entre des bûcherons qui traversent la nuit dans un canot d'écorce et des garnements qui courent comme des damnés sur une galerie.

programme.title: L'histoire du coin à Longueuil
programme.desc: Le R-100 est un ballon dirigeable britannique qui a été amarré à Saint-Hubert à l'été 1930 ; le R-100 a fait courir les foules du Québec, de l'Ontario et des États-Unis et il a contribué au développement de l'aéroport de Saint-Hubert.

programme.title: Justice et châtiments
programme.desc: De l'Antiquité aux débats actuels, cet épisode retrace la manière dont les sociétés ont successivement toléré, condamné puis redéfini la diversité sexuelle et de genre. Des accusations de sodomie aux bûchers médiévaux, des persécutions nazies aux descentes policières dans les bars gais, l'Histoire révèle un long usage du droit pour exclure.

programme.title: Décarboner autrement
programme.desc: Au Québec, les transports sont responsables du tiers des gaz à effet de serre émis dans l'atmosphère ; pour améliorer ce bilan, on peut électrifier les véhicules ; mais ça sera difficile pour les camions lourds.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Une étoile, c'est ni plus ni moins qu'une immense boule de gaz qui produit d'énormes quantités d'énergie sous forme de chaleur et de lumière. On estime que notre Soleil est âgé d'environ 4,6 milliards d'années et, comme toutes les étoiles, il a pris forme dans une nébuleuse et prendra fin lorsqu'il aura épuisé sa réserve d'énergie.

programme.title: Les perles de Lauberivière
programme.desc: À Lauberivière, la crise de l'itinérance se vit chaque jour sur le terrain; une intervenante doit annoncer à plusieurs personnes que le refuge affiche complet, alors qu'un usager se désorganise et que la police doit être appelée; santé mentale, consommation, cohabitation dans le quartier, manque de place: les intervenant.e.s doivent composer avec des situations de plus en plus complexes; pour y faire face, l'équipe mise sur une gestion participative.

programme.title: Dehors, l'école!
programme.desc: L'anxiété est plus présente qu'avant chez les jeunes et la surexposition aux écrans y joue un rôle ; l'école en plein air peut contrer ce phénomène en reconnectant les jeunes à la nature et en favorisant les interactions sociales ; à l'École secondaire Monseigneur-Richard, à Verdun, les élèves sont initiés à la pêche au brochet ; on assiste à un cours de science exaltant, en extérieur, à l'École secondaire de l'Odyssée, à Valcourt.

programme.title: Naissances du futur
programme.desc: La cryoconservation des ovules, initialement conçue pour préserver la fertilité des patientes atteintes de maladies graves, est désormais utilisée pour repousser la maternité de quelques années ; cette avancée promet liberté et contrôle, mais soulève des questions sur son efficacité réelle, son coût élevé et son encadrement éthique ; entre progrès médical et logique commerciale, on s'interroge sur la transformation de la fertilité en un bien à conserver.

programme.title: Substances
programme.desc: La cocaïne, de plus en plus populaire et banalisée, est aujourd'hui la drogue illégale la plus consommée au Canada; souvent associée aux milieux festifs, elle s'invite aussi parfois dans le cadre professionnel; on explore la place de cette substance.

programme.title: De garde 24/7
programme.desc: Le parcours des patients peut être marqué par différentes fins : celle d'un traitement, de la maladie ou de la vie.

programme.title: Parlons job
programme.desc: Il y a un siècle, à Hull, des ouvrières d'une usine d'allumettes développent une maladie grave de la mâchoire à cause d'une exposition au phosphore blanc ; dans les décennies qui suivent, la présence de substances toxiques s'accroît en milieu de travail, entraînant nombre de maladies professionnelles ; les toxicologues industriels entrent alors en scène ; un de leurs succès : l'outil informatique Mixie, développé à l'IRSST, qui permet de quantifier l'effet sur la santé.

programme.title: La clinique des mots
programme.desc: Vaginose, vaginite, vaginalite, vaginoplastie : un de ces mots n'est pas en lien avec les organes génitaux féminins.

programme.title: Hallucinant!
programme.desc: On explore ce qui se passe dans le cerveau d'une personne qui consomme de l'alcool.

programme.title: Hallucinant!
programme.desc: On explore les effets du cannabis sur les récepteurs du cerveau qui sont responsables de différentes sensations et émotions.

programme.title: La préhistoire du Québec
programme.desc: Patrick rencontre le géologue Jonathan O'Neil qui fait part des incroyables découvertes effectuées dans le nord du Québec, là où subsistent des morceaux de la croûte terrestre primordiale encore intacts.

programme.title: La préhistoire du Québec
programme.desc: Possiblement la plus ancienne chaîne de montagnes de la planète, les Laurentides ont de quoi étonner ; l'érosion des millénaires en a beaucoup réduit la taille, mais un milliard d'années n'ont pas suffi pour les effacer complètement.

programme.title: La préhistoire du Québec
programme.desc: Il y a environ 500 millions d'années, le Québec se trouvait au niveau de l'équateur, partiellement submergé par les eaux chaudes d'un océan ancien; à cette époque aucune créature ne foulait la terre ferme, mais les flots regorgeaient d'êtres vivants.

programme.title: L'histoire du coin à Longueuil
programme.desc: Roméo Vachon est un pilote et mécanicien d'avion qui a grandement influencé les débuts de l'aviation au Québec ; d'ailleurs, le parc qui lui rend hommage est situé à proximité de l'aéroport de Saint-Hubert.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Dans notre voisinage céleste, il y a une foule d'objets qu'on peine parfois à définir. Parmi tous ces genres de cailloux qui animent notre système solaire, comment distinguer une comète d'un astéroïde ? Et quelle est la différence entre un météore, un météoroïde et une météorite ? Ils ont toutefois quelque chose en commun : tous pourraient atterrir sur notre planète !

programme.title: Petits curieux, grands écrans
programme.desc: Les vidéos pour tout-petits promettent de favoriser leur développement, mais ces promesses sont sans fondement ; avant trois ans, les enfants ne comprennent pas vraiment ce qu'ils voient à l'écran et ne peuvent pas le transposer à la réalité.

programme.title: La préhistoire du Québec
programme.desc: En 1843, un énorme fossile dont la forme évoque un tronc d'arbre est déniché en Gaspésie ; cet étrange spécimen poussant aux côtés de psilophytes, l'une des premières plantes terrestres connues, n'était pourtant pas un végétal.

programme.title: La préhistoire du Québec
programme.desc: C'est au Québec qu'un groupe de poissons a développé une particularité absolument renversante : des nageoires osseuses qui allaient éventuellement évoluer vers les premières pattes ; on parle ici des ancêtres de tous les animaux vertébrés terrestres.

programme.title: La préhistoire du Québec
programme.desc: En 1965, le géologue Jehan Rondot lève le voile sur l'un des chapitres les plus renversants de la préhistoire du Québec : Charlevoix est en réalité la gigantesque cicatrice d'impact d'une météorite qui s'y est écrasée il y a 400 millions d'années.

programme.title: La préhistoire du Québec
programme.desc: Pourquoi n'a-t-on toujours pas trouvé de fossiles de dinosaures au Québec ; Patrick discute des hypothèses émises pour expliquer ce curieux phénomène et entreprend un voyage aux États-Unis pour admirer les traces fossilisées.

programme.title: La préhistoire du Québec
programme.desc: Il y a 66 millions d'années, l'époque tropicale du Québec tire à sa fin, amorçant sa transformation en terre nordique et froide ; ce phénomène est une mauvaise nouvelle pour les reptiles, mais il crée de nouvelles possibilités pour d'autres animaux.

programme.title: La préhistoire du Québec
programme.desc: On replonge il y a 13 000 ans, à l'époque où le Québec était inondé, suite à la fonte des glaciers ; les quelque 55 000 km de long de cette ancienne mer engloutiraient aujourd'hui les villes de Montréal, Trois-Rivières et Québec.

programme.title: La préhistoire du Québec
programme.desc: Il y a 20 000 ans, des chasseurs-cueilleurs se sont retrouvés à leur insu sur le continent ; Patrick visite le site où les plus anciennes traces de présence humaine connues au Québec ont été découvertes, près de Lac-Mégantic.

programme.title: Condensé de science
programme.desc: Tout le monde connaît l'équation E = mc2, développée par Albert Einstein au début du 20e siècle ; on découvre ce qu'elle signifie et pourquoi elle est si importante.

programme.title: Générations sous pression
programme.desc: On plonge dans le burn-out existentiel : tout semble réussi, mais rien n'a de sens. Entre épuisement professionnel, ruptures, perte de désir et bouleversements hormonaux, cette génération touche ses limites. Quand la réussite ne suffit plus à combler le vide intérieur, la quarantaine devient une ligne de fracture où corps et esprit se confrontent à leurs limites.

programme.title: La préhistoire du Québec
programme.desc: Beaucoup de dinosaures célèbres, comme le T. rex, n'auraient jamais pu se rendre jusqu'au Québec. Quels dinosaures et autres créatures fascinantes pouvait-on retrouver sur notre territoire il y a 140 millions d'années ? Même si les fossiles se font rares, un paléontologue nous partage ses récentes découvertes excavées près d'une mine de Shefferville.

programme.title: Créateurs de demain
programme.desc: S'habiller autrement pour réduire l'empreinte écologique.

programme.title: Trouvez l'erreur
programme.desc: Lors d'une manifestation, la force est dans le nombre ; être solitaire, c'est bien, être solidaire en groupe, c'est mieux ; à ne pas confondre.

programme.title: Les lieux de pouvoir au Québec
programme.desc: Le bunker est un édifice mal-aimé à cause de son architecture brutaliste. C'est là que se sont déroulés tous les Conseils des ministres de Robert Bourassa à Bernard Landry et que se trouvait le bureau du premier ministre à la même période. Aujourd'hui, les négociations entre le secteur public et le gouvernement ont généralement lieu au rez-de-chaussée. Martine Tremblay nous raconte les dessous de la fin du mandat de René Lévesque, dont elle était cheffe de cabinet.

programme.title: Le tour du sujet
programme.desc: L'usage de la pornographie est-il problématique? Au-delà des stéréotypes, certains aspects peuvent-ils être positifs? Quels sont les enjeux reliés à son usage? Le professeur au Département de sexologie de l'UQAM Simon Corneau nous présente son livre "Pornographies: L'essentiel des savoirs et enjeux"; cet ouvrage propose un regard critique nuancé afin d'amener le public à se forger son opinion sur ce sujet tabou et complexe.

programme.title: Hallucinant!
programme.desc: On s'intéresse aux origines du GHB, ce qu'on appelle communément la drogue du viol.

programme.title: La guerre des cerveaux
programme.desc: Les algorithmes structurent notre accès à l'information en analysant nos émotions et nos comportements. Pensés pour capter l'attention, ils deviennent des outils puissants de manipulation : ils filtrent le réel, renforcent les biais, divisent la population et sont exploités dans des stratégies de la guerre cognitive. Comprendre leur fonctionnement, c'est révéler comment le contrôle du code peut orienter le narratif, influencer les sociétés et fragiliser le tissu social en...

programme.title: SOS pieds en détresse
programme.desc: Une femme avec des orteils horriblement disloqués et un homme qui marche sur ses ongles de pied rendent visite au Dr. Brad et à la Dre. Ebonie.

programme.title: La famille Groulx
programme.desc: Ça bouge chez les Groulx; une nouvelle étape dans la vie de Tristan: il est accepté à l'université; Pascal a finalement deux offres d'emploi et doit se décider rapidement.

programme.title: La famille Groulx
programme.desc: Ce n'est pas la venue imminente du bébé numéro 12 qui viendra changer les plans d'été de la famille Groulx; au menu, une célébration et une séance photo pour souligner la fin d'un cycle scolaire de Logan, Tristan et Bianca.

programme.title: La famille Groulx
programme.desc: Tara finalise les tout derniers préparatifs pour l'école comme pour l'hôpital; les enfants seront seuls à la maison, sans grands-parents, lors de son accouchement.

programme.title: Vendre ou rénover au Québec
programme.desc: Johanne et Régis sont en couple depuis plus de 30 ans et habitent leur grande maison de Longueuil depuis une douzaine d'années.

programme.desc: Les médecins Ebonie et Brad s'occupent d'une danseuse qui revient pour une nouvelle intervention chirurgicale.

programme.title: SOS pieds en détresse
programme.desc: Un homme qui urine sur ses pieds et une femme qui dit marcher comme une sauterelle rendent visite aux médecins.

programme.title: SOS pieds en détresse
programme.desc: Une patiente avec un problème d'ongles d'orteil et une femme dont le gros orteil est presque complètement tordu rendent visite aux médecins.

programme.title: The Ghost and Mrs. Muir
programme.desc: Defying her conventional in-laws, young widow Lucy Muir (Gene Tierney) leaves London with her young daughter and moves away for a quieter life in a secluded seaside cottage. Lucy discovers the ghost of the deceased former owner, sea captain Daniel Gregg (Rex Harrison), is haunting the house, but gathers the courage to stand up to him, and woman and ghost become friends. Faced with dwindling means of support, Lucy agrees to the Captain's challenge to write his colorful life story.

programme.title: What Ever Happened to Baby Jane?
programme.desc: Jane Hudson (Bette Davis) is an aging child star left to care for her wheelchair-bound sister Blanche (Joan Crawford), also a former child actress. Stuck living together in a mansion in old Hollywood, Blanche plots to get even with Jane for the car crash that left her crippled years earlier. But Jane is desperate to keep Blanche imprisoned as she plans a new rise to fame, and tries to hide Blanche's existence from doctors, visitors and neighbors while she devises a way to get rid of her sister.

programme.title: Hush... Hush, Sweet Charlotte
programme.desc: Forty years ago, on the night they were meant to elope, Charlotte Hollis (Bette Davis) found her lover decapitated during a party, the blood on her dress leading everyone to suspect she was the murderer. Now, in 1964, Charlotte is an old recluse and must fight to keep her home. She enlists the help of her cousin Velma (Olivia de Havilland), who was there at the time of the murder. However, soon after Velma's arrival, Charlotte's mind becomes unstable, and she starts seeing her dead lover's head.

programme.title: The Other
programme.desc: After their father dies, young twin brothers Holland (Martin Udvarnoky) and Niles (Chris Udvarnoky) spend their summer playing around the farm, while their mother (Diana Muldaur) hides in mourning. Holland is the more mischievous of the two, while Niles is shy and quiet. Their grandmother, Ada (Uta Hagen), has taught Niles how to project himself into other people and animals as a harmless game. But when a series of deadly tragedies strike the family and friends, only Ada suspects the truth.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel
programme.desc: Confederate veteran John Chandler (Alan Ladd) returns from defeat in war to find his home razed, his wife dead and his young son, David (David Ladd), traumatized and rendered mute. Desperate to cure the boy, Chandler takes David to a small town in Illinois where he hopes to find a doctor. But, soon after the pair arrives, Chandler finds himself framed for assault -- and forced to choose between serving hard time and working for struggling local farmer Linnett Moore (Olivia de Havilland).

programme.title: Outlaws of the Plains
programme.desc: An impressionable cowpoke, Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), hears a voice claiming to be that of an old Native American, telling him the location of some hidden gold. Fuzzy does find gold, but the land has already been claimed by Nord Finner (Charles King Jr.). Finner offers to sell his claim, and Fuzzy is eager to buy. Then Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe), a friend of Fuzzy's, shows up and discovers that a gang of outlaws is behind a scheme to rob everyone in the area.

programme.title: Pioneer Justice
programme.desc: Something strange is going on in the frontier town of Buffalo Gap. After two men turn up dead, a marshal named Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) arrives, along with his partner, Fuzzy Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), to investigate. Although the outlaw Bill Judd (Jack Ingram) seems to be behind the deaths, the sheriff is not taking any action. When Cheyenne learns the sheriff may be taking orders from another party, he and Fuzzy try to find out who is controlling the criminal element.

programme.title: Romance of the West
programme.desc: Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), along with his sidekick, Ezra (Emmett Lynn), oversees the peaceful coexistence of the Native American tribes with the white settlers of Antelope Valley. The treaty that binds the two groups is threatened when some of the town leaders learn that the Native American land contains rich deposits of silver. Eager to oust the tribes and claim the silver, the town leaders try to provoke an attack that would break the treaty. It's up to Eddie to stop them in time.

programme.title: The Tioga Kid
programme.desc: With assistance from partner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), Texas Ranger Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) helps rancher Jenny Morgan (Jennifer Holt) recover her stolen herd. For Eddie, the theft comes as a shock, as it may have been perpetrated by his twin, who is known as "the Tioga Kid" (also Dean). Suddenly, the brothers are at odds as never before. Things get even dicier when wanted posters depict a man who looks exactly like Eddie, causing some to believe that he's actually the bad guy.

programme.title: The Dawn Rider
programme.desc: John Mason (John Wayne) suffers a cruel homecoming when he witnesses his father's murder as he rides into town. Incensed, he chases after the killers, but he suffers a gunshot wound that cuts his pursuit short. Alice Gordon (Marion Burns) sees to his injury, and Mason is taken by her kindness and beauty. But things turn sour when her beau, Ben (Reed Howes), becomes jealous. After Mason discovers the men who killed his father, his plan for a duel is sabotaged by Ben, who has been manipulated.

programme.title: Check Your Guns
programme.desc: Gunslinger Eddie (Eddie Dean) rides into the Wild West town of Red Gap, Colo., which is run by land-hungry saloon owner Brad Taggert (Stan Jolley) and corrupt circuit judge Hammond (Bill Fawcett). When the sheriff is killed by members of Taggert's gang, Eddie is appointed to take his place. Along with his deputy, barbershop owner Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates), and ranch owner Cathy Jordan (Nancy Gates), Eddie takes aim at Taggert and his gang, led by sharpshooter Ace Bannion (Mikel Conrad).

programme.title: The Desert Trail
programme.desc: John Scott (John Wayne) is a rodeo rider, assisted by his buddy Kansas Charlie (Eddy Chandler). But while the duo is settling a debt with their promoter, Farnsworth (Henry Hall), thieves Pete (Al Ferguson) and Jim (Paul Fix) murder and rob Farnsworth and manage to pin the crimes on John and Charlie. The accused then flee, assume two new identities, take up with a shopkeeper named Anne (Mary Kornman) and set out to clear their names and bring the real killers to justice.

programme.title: Cheyenne Takes Over
programme.desc: U.S. Marshal Cheyenne (Al "Lash" La Rue) and his sidekick, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are en route to a much-needed vacation at Fuzzy's friend's ranch. But, upon arriving, the partners find that Fuzzy's pal has been killed, and a fishy group of characters has taken over the ranch, claiming to have inherited it from the dead man. Immediately suspicious, the lawmen team up with local saloon owner Fay Wilkins (Nancy Gates), and forgo their vacation in favor of a murder investigation.

programme.title: The Man From Utah
programme.desc: One day, John Weston (John Wayne) helps stop a bank robbery. George Higgins (George Hayes), the town's grateful marshal, asks Weston for his help in solving another crime. It seems someone at a touring rodeo show is killing the top riders before they can take home the trophy -- and the prize money. Weston agrees to investigate and works his way into the show, which is run by the shady Spike Barton (Edward Peil). As Weston gets closer to the truth, he finds himself in even greater danger.

programme.title: Rimfire
programme.desc: An undercover Army captain (James Millican) links missing gold and murder to a gambler's (Reed Hadley) ghost.

programme.title: Under California Stars
programme.desc: Returning to his California ranch for some rest and relaxation, cowboy movie star Roy Rogers finds himself drawn into battle with a dastardly group of horse rustlers. Taking pity on Ted, a young man who was disabled in a riding accident, Roy offers him a job on the ranch. But Ted's stepfather, Lige, leads a gang of thieves posing as wild-horse wranglers, and their prime target is Roy's famous horse, Trigger, which they kidnap for ransom.

programme.title: In Old Amarillo
programme.desc: A villainous cannery owner tries to foil efforts to get water to cattle ranchers during a severe drought.

programme.title: The Proud Rebel

programme.desc: At the start of the New Year, 32-year-old Bridget (Renée Zellweger) decides it's time to take control of her life -- and start keeping a diary. Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life.

programme.title: The Firm
programme.desc: A young lawyer joins a small but prestigious law firm only to find out that most of their clients are on the wrong side of the law. The company is helping to launder mob money, get clients off charges and even murder partners who threaten to blow their cover, but when the FBI come calling to gather evidence on the lawyer's colleagues, he is caught between a rock and a hard place, juggling his life and his liberty.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated.

programme.title: Love & Basketball
programme.desc: Monica (Sanaa Lathan) and Quincy (Omar Epps) are two childhood friends who both aspire to be professional basketball players. Quincy, whose father, Zeke (Dennis Haysbert), plays for the Los Angeles Clippers, is a natural talent and a born leader. Monica is ferociously competitive but sometimes becomes overly emotional on the court. Over the years, the two begin to fall for each other, but their separate paths to basketball stardom threaten to pull them apart.

programme.title: Failure to Launch
programme.desc: A young man (Matthew McConaughey) continues to live at the home of parents who, in desperation to push him out of the nest once and for all, hatch a plan. They hire a beautiful woman (Sarah Jessica Parker) to entice him to assume the mantle of responsibility and get his own place.

programme.title: Horrible Bosses
programme.desc: Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) are workers who would like nothing better than to grind their oppressive employers into the dirt. Quitting their jobs is not an option, so -- fueled by alcohol and dubious advice from a criminal (Jamie Foxx) -- the men devise a complex and seemingly foolproof plan to permanently rid themselves of their terrible bosses. The problem is, any plan is only as clever as the brains behind it.

programme.title: Horrible Bosses 2
programme.desc: Tired of always answering to others, Nick (Jason Bateman), Dale (Charlie Day) and Kurt (Jason Sudeikis) go into business for themselves. After demonstrating the prototype for an invention called the Shower Buddy, the guys attract the attention of Rex Hanson and his father, Bert. Bert invests in the trio's product, then cancels the order and steals their idea. Now heavily in debt and with no legal recourse, Nick, Dale and Kurt decide to kidnap Rex and use the ransom money to pay off their loans.

programme.title: Just Go With It
programme.desc: His heart recently broken, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) pretends to be married so he can enjoy future dates with no strings attached. His web of lies works, but when he meets Palmer (Brooklyn Decker) -- the gal of his dreams -- she resists involvement. Instead of coming clean, Danny enlists Katherine (Jennifer Aniston), his assistant, to pose as his soon-to-be-ex-wife. Instead of solving Danny's problems, the lies create more trouble.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive.

programme.title: The Crossing Guard
programme.desc: For six excruciating years, Freddy Gale (Jack Nicholson) has fantasized about taking bloody revenge on John Booth (David Morse), the drunk driver responsible for the traffic accident that killed his daughter. On the last day of Booth's prison sentence, a grief-stricken Gale informs his ex-wife, Mary (Anjelica Huston), of his intentions, then follows Booth to a mobile home in the suburbs. There, with hands shaking, Gale draws his gun -- and steps into a dark and uncertain future.

programme.title: Below
programme.desc: The submarine U.S.S. Manta had a perfect record until the mysterious death of its captain. The next-in-command, Lt. Richard Brice (Bruce Greenwood) is determined to steer his disheartened crew back to safety. But after three battle survivors board the sub, bizarre and frightening things begin to happen. As the tale unfolds, and crew members begin to disappear, Ensign Douglas O'Dell (Matthew Davis) must piece together the puzzles of the submarine's past before it is too late to resurface alive.

programme.title: Winchester
programme.desc: The most haunted house in the world sits on an isolated stretch of land that's 50 miles outside of San Francisco. Built by Sarah Winchester, heiress to the Winchester fortune, it stands seven stories tall and contains hundreds of rooms. To an outsider, it looks like a monstrous monument to a disturbed woman's madness. But Sarah's actually building a prison, an asylum for hundreds of vengeful ghosts -- and the most terrifying among them have a score to settle with the Winchesters.

programme.title: House at the End of the Street
programme.desc: In search of a fresh start, divorcee Sarah (Elisabeth Shue) and her daughter, Elissa (Max Thieriot), find their dream house in a small town. But when startling, unexplainable events begin, the pair learn that a chilling secret holds the town in its grip. Years earlier a girl killed her parents and disappeared, leaving a brother, Ryan (Max Thieriot), as the sole survivor. Elissa begins a relationship with Ryan, and the closer they get, the deeper they're all pulled into a dangerous mystery.

programme.title: Dodgeball: A True Underdog Story
programme.desc: Average Joe's Gym and its owner, Peter La Fleur (Vince Vaughn), are both down on their luck. A fancy competing gym called Globo-Gym, run by the maniacal health nut White Goodman (Ben Stiller), is about to put Average Joe's out of business unless Peter can raise $50,000 to keep his mortgage. To save the gym, Peter and a ragtag group of Average Joe's members and employees enter a dodgeball contest with a big cash prize. In response, White forms his own Globo-Gym team to rout the competition.

programme.title: Wild Wild West
programme.desc: When President Ulysses S. Grant (Kevin Kline) learns that diabolical inventor Dr. Arliss Loveless (Kenneth Branagh) is planning to assassinate him, he orders Civil War hero James West (Will Smith) and U.S. Marshal Artemus Gordon (also Kline) to arrest him. West's trigger-happy personality doesn't always mesh well with that of the thoughtful Gordon, but they manage to work together. And with the help of a mysterious stranger (Salma Hayek), West and Gordon close in on Loveless.

programme.title: The Gift
programme.desc: In the tiny town of Brixton, Georgia where nothing is private, a woman with supernatural clairvoyance, a young beautiful socialite who has mysteriously disappeared, and an assortment of colorful characters all collide. A haunting psychological thriller, "The Gift" is ultimately a profound celebration of the human spirit.

programme.title: The Yards
programme.desc: After serving time in prison for taking the fall for a group of his friends, Leo just wants to get his life back on track. So he goes to the one place he thinks will be safe -- home. There he takes a new job with his highly connected and influential uncle. But in the yards, where his uncle now pulls the strings, safe is not how they do business. Unwittingly, he's drawn into a world of sabotage, high stakes payoffs and even murder.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller.

programme.title: A.I.: Artificial Intelligence
programme.desc: A robotic boy, the first programmed to love, David is adopted as a test case by a Cybertronics employee and his wife. Though he gradually becomes their child, a series of unexpected circumstances make this life impossible for David. Without final acceptance by humans or machines, David embarks on a journey to discover where he truly belongs, uncovering a world in which the line between robot and machine is both vast and profoundly thin.

programme.title: Star Trek: First Contact
programme.desc: The Enterprise and its crew follow a Borg ship through a time warp to prevent the Borg from taking over the Earth in a past era. Stuck in the past, Geordi La Forge helps a pioneer of space travel in his efforts to create the first warp drive while Capt. Picard and Cmdr. Data battle the Borg Queen as she tries to take over the Enterprise.

programme.title: Star Trek: The Motion Picture
programme.desc: The Federation calls on Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the Starship Enterprise to contain an immense nimbused object that's on a crash course with Earth. After investigating, the crew discovers that the alien cloud harbors artificial intelligence with an ominous primary directive. Crisis strikes when a probe dispatched by the energy cloud attacks the crew, abducting navigator Lt. Ilia (Persis Khambatta). An android look-alike containing her memories shows up soon after.

programme.title: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
programme.desc: Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) has defeated his archenemy but at great cost. His friend Spock has apparently been killed, the USS Enterprise is being scrapped, and starship physician Dr. Leonard "Bones" McCoy (DeForest Kelley) has taken ill. McCoy's odd behavior is evidence he's harboring Spock's katra, or animating spirit, and Kirk seeks to take the Enterprise back to the Genesis Planet and find his friend. Rebuffed, Kirk takes dramatic action that results in war with deadly Klingons.

programme.title: Bran Nue Dae
programme.desc: A rebellious young man runs away from home but returns after experiencing an amazing journey.

programme.title: The Spiderwick Chronicles
programme.desc: Of the three Grace children, Jared has always been thought of as the troublemaker. So when strange things happen after his family's move to a relative's dilapidated estate, sister Mallory, twin brother Simon and their mother assume that Jared is behind it all. However, magical creatures roam the grounds, and they all want a special book that Jared has found: a field guide to fantastic creatures, penned by Arthur Spiderwick.

programme.title: Nancy Drew
programme.desc: Amateur sleuth Nancy Drew (Emma Roberts) accompanies her father (Tate Donovan) on a business trip to Los Angeles and stumbles across evidence in the case of a movie star's long-unsolved death. The young heroine's resourcefulness and integrity are put to the test in the glamorous -- but sometimes treacherous -- world of Hollywood.

programme.title: View From the Top
programme.desc: A comedy about a young woman from meager beginnings, who has high hopes for the future. Donna (Gwyneth Paltrow) dreams of becoming a first-class international flight attendant and is willing to do whatever it takes to ensure that her dreams come true. The road to success, though, is rarely a smooth flight, and as she begins her trip she encounters more turbulence than even she bargained for.

programme.title: She's the Man
programme.desc: Romantic complications ensue when a student poses as her twin brother and replaces him at his boarding school.

programme.title: The Terminal
programme.desc: When Viktor Navorski (Tom Hanks), an Eastern European tourist, arrives at JFK in New York, war breaks out in his country, and he finds himself caught up in international politics. Because of the war, the Department of Homeland Security won't let him enter or exit the United States. He's trapped at JFK -- indefinitely. While living at the airport, Viktor falls for a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones). She may have feelings for him too. But what good is love if Viktor can't leave the terminal?

programme.title: You've Got Mail
programme.desc: Struggling boutique bookseller Kathleen Kelly hates Joe Fox, the owner of a corporate Foxbooks chain store that just moved in across the street. When they meet online, however, they begin an intense and anonymous Internet romance, oblivious of each other's true identity. Eventually Joe learns that the enchanting woman he's involved with is actually his business rival. He must now struggle to reconcile his real-life dislike for her with the cyber love he's come to feel.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents: Dracula 2000
programme.desc: Long ago, Abraham Van Helsing (Christopher Plummer) imprisoned the infamous Count Dracula (Gerard Butler) within a vault inside Carfax Abbey. In the present day, Van Helsing relies on Dracula's immortal blood to remain alive. But then thieves break into the vault and steal the vampire's coffin, thinking it contains something valuable. Liberated from his prison, Dracula seizes the opportunity to escape, but Van Helsing sets out to banish him to the crypt once again.

programme.title: Wes Craven Presents Dracula II: Ascension
programme.desc: After a band of medical students receives a decaying but living body reported to be the vampire Count Dracula (Stephen Billington), they set out to harness his power and immortality. As a bonus, their mentor, Lowell (Craig Sheffer), claims that there is a mysterious donor willing to fund their research. During the study, student Elizabeth Blaine (Diane Neal) injures herself on the vampire's tooth and starts to feel strange. Soon, vampire hunter Father Uffizi (Jason Scott Lee) is on their trail.

programme.title: Marshmallow
programme.desc: A 12-year-old boy starts to see a shadowy figure in the woods after hearing a spooky story at summer camp.

programme.title: The Woman in Black
programme.desc: Arthur Kipps, a lawyer, is recently widowed and grieving the loss of his wife when he is sent to a remote village to put a deceased eccentric's affairs in order. Soon after his arrival, it becomes clear that the villagers are hiding a terrible secret. Kipps discovers that his late client's house is haunted by the spirit of a woman who is trying to find someone and something she lost, and that no one -- not even the children -- is safe from her terrible wrath.

programme.title: 16 Shots
programme.desc: A Chicago police officer is charged with murder after the shooting of Laquan McDonald.

programme.title: The Ring
programme.desc: It sounds like just another urban legend -- a videotape filled with nightmarish images leads to a phone call foretelling the viewer's death in exactly seven days. Newspaper reporter Rachel Keller (Naomi Watts) is skeptical of the story until four teenagers all die mysteriously exactly one week after watching just such a tape. Allowing her investigative curiosity to get the better of her, Rachel tracks down the video and watches it. Now she has just seven days to unravel the mystery.

programme.title: Crawlspace
programme.desc: After witnessing a brutal murder in a cabin, a man hides in a crawlspace while the killers scour the property for a hidden fortune. As they draw nearer, he must decide if the crawlspace will be his tomb or the battleground in his fight for survival.

programme.title: Tales From the Darkside: The Movie
programme.desc: The first of three dark tales involves resentful student Bellingham (Steve Buscemi) looking to an Egyptian mummy for help in settling some scores. Then, hit man Halston (David Johansen) is contracted to kill a cat that has terrorized and even killed members of an extremely wealthy family. Lastly, struggling artist Preston (James Remar) witnesses a demon commit a bizarre murder on a city street, but agrees to keep it a secret when the devilish being promises wealth in return for his silence.

programme.title: Band Aid
programme.desc: Anna and Ben can't stop fighting. Advised by their therapist to try and work through their grief unconventionally, they are reminded of their shared love of music. In a last-ditch effort to save their marriage, they decide to turn all of their fights into songs, and with the help of their neighbor, Dave, they start a band.

programme.title: The Outlaws
programme.desc: A group of outlaws awaken to their empty train heist bag. Interrogations begin as each cowboy becomes the focus in an attempt to unmask the thief among them. Tensions mount as each bandit struggles to clear their name before bullets fly.

programme.title: Memory
programme.desc: Social worker Sylvia's structured life is blown apart when Saul follows her home from their high school reunion. Their surprise encounter profoundly impacts both of them as they open the door to the past.

programme.title: Confess, Fletch
programme.desc: While investigating a case of stolen paintings, the roguishly charming and endlessly troublesome Fletch becomes the prime suspect in a murder. To prove his innocence, he must sift through a long list of suspects, including his own girlfriend.

programme.title: Magic Mike
programme.desc: By day, Mike (Channing Tatum) makes ends meet any way he can -- handyman jobs, detailing cars or designing furniture. But nighttime is when Mike really gets to display his many talents: He's the hot headliner in an all-male revue. Mike sees potential in a 19-year-old he dubs the Kid (Alex Pettyfer), takes the teen under his wing and instructs him in the tricks of the trade. However, Mike learns there's a downside to the stripper lifestyle when it threatens his romance with the Kid's sister.

programme.title: Doctor Sleep
programme.desc: Struggling with alcoholism, Dan Torrance remains traumatized by the sinister events that occurred at the Overlook Hotel when he was a child. His hope for a peaceful existence soon becomes shattered when he meets Abra, a teen who shares his extrasensory gift of the "shine." Together, they form an unlikely alliance to battle the True Knot, a cult whose members try to feed off the shine of innocents to become immortal.

programme.title: 300: Rise of an Empire
programme.desc: Xerxes, driven by vengeance for his father's death, leads an army against Greece; Greek city-states join forces under Athens' command to fight Artemisia in a naval battle.

programme.title: Coneheads
programme.desc: Cone-headed extraterrestrials Beldar (Dan Aykroyd) and Prymaat (Jane Curtin) find themselves in New Jersey after a recon mission for their home planet of Remulak goes awry. Stranded, they are forced to live as typical suburban humans. Beldar gets a job, and daughter Connie (Michelle Burke) grows up to be a typical, if oddly shaped, teenager. When INS agents start investigating the family and Beldar receives sinister orders from Remulak, the Coneheads must decide where their allegiance lies.

programme.title: The Dark Tower
programme.desc: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower, the key that holds the universe together. With the fate of worlds at stake, two men collide in the ultimate battle between good and evil.

programme.title: The Saint
programme.desc: A clever thief who is known as the master of creating false identities using the names of Catholic saints, is hired by the Russian Mafia for his next mission. But things get complicated when he falls for Emma Russel, the scientist.

programme.title: Ghost in the Shell
programme.desc: In the near future, Major is the first of her kind: a human who is cyber-enhanced to be a perfect soldier devoted to stopping the world's most dangerous criminals. When terrorism reaches a new level that includes the ability to hack into people's minds and control them, Major is uniquely qualified to stop it. As she prepares to face a new enemy, Major discovers that her life was stolen instead of saved. Now, she will stop at nothing to recover her past while punishing those who did this to her.

programme.title: 10 Cloverfield Lane
programme.desc: After surviving a car accident, Michelle (Mary Elizabeth Winstead) wakes up to find herself in an underground bunker with two men. Howard (John Goodman) tells her that a massive chemical attack has rendered the air unbreathable, and their only hope of survival is to remain inside. Despite the comforts of home, Howard's controlling and menacing nature makes Michelle want to escape. After taking matters into her own hands, the young woman finally discovers the truth about the outside world.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive.

programme.title: Grizzly Night
programme.desc: On August 12th, 1967, in Montana's Glacier National Park, the unthinkable happens, and on the same night, nine miles apart, there are two fatal grizzly bear attacks.

programme.title: Blade Runner 2049
programme.desc: Officer K (Ryan Gosling), a new Blade Runner for the Los Angeles Police Department, unearths a long-buried secret that has the potential to plunge what's left of society into chaos. His discovery leads him on a quest to find Rick Deckard (Harrison Ford), a former Blade Runner who's been missing for 30 years.

programme.title: Terminator 2: Judgment Day
programme.desc: In this sequel set eleven years after "The Terminator," young John Connor (Edward Furlong), the key to civilization's victory over a future robot uprising, is the target of the shape-shifting T-1000 (Robert Patrick), a Terminator sent from the future to kill him. Another Terminator, the revamped T-800 (Arnold Schwarzenegger), has been sent back to protect the boy. As John and his mother (Linda Hamilton) go on the run with the T-800, the boy forms an unexpected bond with the robot.

programme.title: Basic Instinct
programme.desc: The mysterious Catherine Tramell, a beautiful crime novelist, becomes a suspect when she is linked to the brutal death of a rock star. Investigated by homicide detective Nick Curran, Catherine seduces him into an intense relationship. Meanwhile, the murder case becomes increasingly complicated when more seemingly connected deaths occur and Nick's psychologist and lover, Beth Garner, appears to be another suspect.

programme.title: Asylum
programme.desc: An administrator's bored wife (Natasha Richardson) begins a torrid affair with an institutionalized artist (Marton Csokas) who beat his wife to death.

programme.title: Organ Trail
programme.desc: Abigale and her family fall victim to a gang of ruthless cowboys while making their way across the Oregon Trail. As the only survivor, she does whatever it takes to retrieve her family's horse from the clutches of the bloodthirsty bandits.

programme.title: Red Eye
programme.desc: In the wake of her grandmother's funeral, hotel manager Lisa Reisert is waiting to fly back home when she meets charming Jackson Rippner at check-in. She thinks it luck that they're seated together on the plane, but soon learns otherwise. Jackson hopes to assassinate the head of Homeland Security, but to do so, he needs Lisa to reassign the official's room number at her hotel. As insurance, Jackson has kidnapped Lisa's father.

programme.title: You Can Count on Me
programme.desc: Sammy is a single mother who is extremely protective of her 8-year-old son. She is satisfied with living in the small town she grew up in and working in a local bank. When her brother Terry visits he fits the void in the life of both her and her son. Temporarily free of the constraints of single motherhood she begins to break free of her normal routine. In a string of traumatic events Sammy is torn between helping her brother and her maternal instinct to protect her son from getting hurt.

programme.title: Sabrina
programme.desc: Sabrina Fairchild is a chauffeur's daughter who grew up with the wealthy Larrabee family. She always had unreciprocated feelings for David, the family's younger son and playboy. But after returning from Paris, Sabrina has become a glamorous woman who gets David's attention. His older, work-minded brother Linus thinks their courtship is bad for the family business and tries to break them up -- but then he starts to fall for her too.

programme.title: The Bodyguard
programme.desc: Best-selling pop diva Rachel Marron has a stalker whose obsession has risen to the level of disturbing threats. At the urging of her manager, Rachel hires former Secret Service agent Frank Farmer as her bodyguard. Initially resented and treated with disdain for his hard-nosed security procedures, Farmer soon becomes an integral part of Rachel's inner circle. As they spend more time together, client and protector become closer still.

programme.title: Days of Thunder
programme.desc: In the fast-paced world of NASCAR, a rivalry brews between rookie hotshot Cole Trickle (Tom Cruise) and veteran racer Rowdy Burns (Michael Rooker). When both of them are seriously injured in competition, the former bitter rivals become close friends. With Cole's spirits restored by a romance with neurosurgeon Dr. Claire Lewicki (Nicole Kidman), and Rowdy still sidelined by injuries, Cole decides to race Rowdy's car in the Daytona 500 against underhanded newcomer Russ Wheeler (Cary Elwes).

programme.title: The Stepford Wives
programme.desc: After enduring setbacks in her television career, executive Joanna Eberhart (Nicole Kidman) relocates with her family from New York City to the Connecticut suburb of Stepford. While Joanna's husband, Walter (Matthew Broderick), quickly warms up to their new town, she has a hard time adjusting to Stepford's manicured environs and the overly accommodating attitude of the area women. Soon Joanna begins to suspect that something is not right, and she tries to uncover Stepford's secret.

programme.title: Sweetness
programme.desc: When a superfan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. What started as compassion soon turns into captivity as she locks him away in the name of love.

programme.title: A Bad Moms Christmas
programme.desc: Under-appreciated and overburdened moms Amy, Kiki and Carla rebel against the challenges and expectations of the Super Bowl for moms: Christmas. As if creating the perfect holiday for their families isn't hard enough, they'll have to do it while hosting and entertaining their own respective mothers when they come to visit.

programme.title: Nightmare Castle
programme.desc: A deranged scientist, Dr. Stephen Arrowsmith, catches his beautiful wife, Muriel, conducting an affair with their gardener, David. The enraged Arrowsmith imprisons the lovers in his laboratory. Chained to the wall, Muriel and David suffer slow, painful deaths as the vicious Arrowsmith inflicts sadistic torture upon them. Believing he has achieved his vengeance, the doctor isn't pleased when his victims return from the grave to seek theirs.

programme.title: Radio Classics
programme.desc: Paladin aids an Englishman who is determined to make a go of his ranch.

programme.title: True North Classics
programme.desc: The best in short film from the 1930s to 1960s.

programme.title: Postcards From Canada
programme.desc: Images of the East Coast and Canadian Winters.

programme.title: Retrola: Canada's Time Machine
programme.desc: Images of Weddings & Christmas Past.

programme.title: Classroom Classics
programme.desc: Featuring "Am I Trustworthy?" and "Tomorrow's Drivers.".

programme.title: Lux Radio Theatre
programme.desc: A man unjustly imprisoned for 20 years manages to escape and get revenge on those who betrayed him; starring Robert Montgomery.

programme.title: Lux Radio Theatre
programme.desc: The ambitions, dreams and disappointments of aspiring actresses who all live in the same boarding house; starring Ginger Rogers.

programme.title: Lux Radio Theatre
programme.desc: An airline pilot risks his life testing a new anti-icing device.

programme.title: Lux Radio Theatre
programme.desc: A spoiled heiress running away from her family is helped by a reporter in need of a story; starring Clark Gable.

programme.title: Classroom Classics
programme.desc: Featuring "How to Be Well Groomed" and "Holiday From Rules.".

programme.desc: The Lost City of the Jungle

programme.title: Dr. Ho Talks
programme.desc: Dr. Ho discusses getting relief from pain and tension in the comfort of one's home.

programme.title: Trending Now
programme.desc: Taking a dive into the most talked about stories and celebrating the content that drives conversations both online and in homes; delivering insights on world issues while also highlighting viral trends.

programme.title: Dr. Ho Talks
programme.desc: The solution for chronic or acute back pain relief.

programme.title: Trending Now
programme.desc: Taking a dive into the most talked about stories and celebrating the content that drives conversations both online and in homes; delivering insights on world issues while also highlighting viral trends.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: In Santa Mira, California, Dr. Miles Bennell (Kevin McCarthy) is baffled when all his patients come to him with the same complaint: their loved ones seem to have been replaced by emotionless impostors. Despite others' dismissive denials, Dr. Bennell, his former girlfriend Becky (Dana Wynter) and his friend Jack (King Donovan) soon discover that the patients' suspicions are true: an alien species of human duplicates, grown from plant-like pods, is taking over the small town.

programme.title: The Wolf Man
programme.desc: When his brother dies, Larry Talbot (Lon Chaney) returns to Wales and reconciles with his father (Claude Rains). While there, he visits an antique shop and, hoping to impress Gwen (Evelyn Ankers), the attractive shopkeeper, buys a silver walking cane. That same night he kills a wolf with it, only to later learn that he actually killed a man (Bela Lugosi). A gypsy (Maria Ouspenskaya) explains that it was her son, a werewolf, that he killed, and that Larry is now one himself.

programme.title: Creature From the Black Lagoon
programme.desc: Remnants of a mysterious animal have come to light in a remote jungle, and a group of scientists intends to determine if the find is an anomaly or evidence of an undiscovered beast. To accomplish their goal, the scientists (Antonio Moreno, Richard Carlson, Richard Denning, Whit Bissell) must brave the most perilous pieces of land South America has to offer. But the terrain is nothing compared to the danger posed by an otherworldly being that endangers their work and their lives.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: In Santa Mira, California, Dr. Miles Bennell (Kevin McCarthy) is baffled when all his patients come to him with the same complaint: their loved ones seem to have been replaced by emotionless impostors. Despite others' dismissive denials, Dr. Bennell, his former girlfriend Becky (Dana Wynter) and his friend Jack (King Donovan) soon discover that the patients' suspicions are true: an alien species of human duplicates, grown from plant-like pods, is taking over the small town.

programme.title: Mr. Hulot's Holiday

programme.title: Ghost Whisperer

programme.title: Medium

programme.title: Medium

As Dr. Chris immerses himself in culturally diverse destinations, he takes care to uncover each region's best-kept secrets.

But tragedy strikes during a game, when Kenny, the superstar of the family, sustains a fatal heart attack while playing. This forces Antoine to become the leader on the court, but not without some help from his brother, who returns as a ghost to help the Washington team in its quest for glory.

programme.desc: Young Thurgood Marshall faces one of his greatest challenges while working as a lawyer for the NAACP. Marshall travels to conservative Connecticut when wealthy socialite Eleanor Strubing accuses Black chauffeur Joseph Spell of sexual assault and attempted murder. He soon teams up with Sam Friedman, a local Jewish lawyer who's never handled a criminal case. Together, the two men build a defense while contending with racist and anti-Semitic views from those who deem Spell to be guilty.

programme.title: Underworld: Awakening
programme.desc: In the years since she and her human-lycan lover, Michael, defeated Elder Marcus, vampire warrior Selene has been taken captive by humans, while they wage an all-out war against both lycans and vampires. Awakening after more than a decade, Selene discovers that Michael is dead, but that she has given birth to his daughter, Eve. Shunned by nearly all surviving vampires, save one, even Selene seems powerless against her latest opponent: a genetically enhanced lycan.

programme.title: Scary Movie 2

Marlon Wayans and Anna Faris lead a stellar cast that takes extreme pleasure in skewering Hollywood's most frightening feature films and spoofing popular culture. Starring Regina Hall, Christopher Kennedy Masterson, Tori Spelling and Tim Curry, Chris Elliott and James Woods, nothing's sacred and anything goes in this outlandish must-see comedy hit.
