programme.title: Extreme Weather Salvage - Lost Traps and Trucks
programme.desc: Veteran salvor Paul Hay and his team rescue a clam-dredging crew's harvest lost in a storm off the New Jersey coast; following an annual cleanup operation in New Zealand that salvages fishing equipment gone astray. (Reality TV, Environmental)

programme.title: Buried Evidence - Tomb Raiders
programme.desc: Open burial sites filled with secrets. Find powerful artifacts in a French rulers tomb, see what a tomb adorned with conch shells says about sacred ceremonies, and expose complex beliefs about animals and the afterlife in an Egyptian zoo graveyard. (History)

programme.title: Buried Evidence - Ancient Architecture
programme.desc: Puzzling over history-making structures and artifacts; Searching for clues about civilization's origins in Göbekli Tepe, visiting a German statue that reveals symbolic thought; witnessing the brutality of colonization in a Mexican skull tower. (History)

programme.title: Buried Evidence - Out of Place
programme.desc: Learning how displaced artifacts spark fresh investigations and rewrite timelines; unearthing a forgotten tragedy in a remote mountain lake in India, checking out footprints that change human migration stories; reopening an ancient cold case. (History)

programme.title: Buried Evidence - Ancient Beasts
programme.desc: Re-evaluating what we know about evolution, extinction, and animals' sacred roles. Dig up a Canadian dinosaur that sparks questions about fossilization, meet a prehistoric survivor in China, and see the religious parts crocodiles played in Egypt. (History)

programme.title: Buried Evidence - Warriors
programme.desc: Shedding light on the origins of organized warfare and the brutality it left behind; hunting for the beginnings of organized combat in Germany; finding evidence of Roman power in Denmark, and pondering the symbolic role of elite fighters. (History)

programme.title: Rise and Fall of the Aztecs - Origins
programme.desc: In less than 200 years, the Aztecs rose from nomadic origins to build the powerful empire of Tenochtitlan; combining archaeology and stunning 3D reconstructions, this series reveals the rise and fall of a remarkable civilization. (Documentary)

programme.title: Rise and Fall of the Aztecs - Expansion
programme.desc: In less than 200 years, the Aztecs rose from nomadic origins to build the powerful empire of Tenochtitlan; combining archaeology and stunning 3D reconstructions, this series reveals the rise and fall of a remarkable civilization. (Documentary)

programme.title: Rise and Fall of the Aztecs - Blood and Gods
programme.desc: Take a deeper look at the Aztec religion and ritual human sacrifice. Tap into the profound spiritual logic that led priests to offer blood and human hearts in exchange for protection from the gods, who could destroy the universe at any moment. (Documentary)

programme.title: Rise and Fall of the Aztecs - The Fall
programme.desc: Finding out how Spanish explorer Hernán Cortés and a few hundred conquistadores unravelled the fabric of Aztec society; examining the political manoeuvres, rebellions, and cultural misunderstandings that led to the fall of Tenochtitlan in 1521. (Documentary)

programme.desc: Engineers create impossibly shaped buildings: Albany's Egg, a huge, sculpted theatre space, fit for a Rockefeller; a floating fortress in LA, protecting $2bn in art; and giant New York offices towering over America's busiest com. (Instructional)

programme.title: How Did They Fix That? - US Coast Guard: Safeguarding The Seas
programme.desc: Mike helps fix the vessels that the U.S. Coast Guard use to keep the oceans safe; he replaces key parts of ship engines, removes a large crane from a buoy tender, and fixes a helicopter for a critical exercise. (Documentary)

programme.title: Impossible Repairs - Deep Sea Fish Delivery
programme.desc: Venturing into the deep waters of the Caribbean Sea for high stakes repairs on one of the one of the world's largest open ocean fish farm operations. (Reality TV, Performing Arts)

After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw (Tony Shalhoub) and convince him to sign over all his assets to them. programme.title: Cinéma - Ferrari
programme.desc: Enzo Ferrari lance les dés et parie le tout sur une course périlleuse de 1 000 milles à travers l'Italie. (Movies, Drama) - 2023

programme.title: Cinéma - Distorsions
programme.desc: L'animatrice d'un balado populaire sur les phénomènes paranormaux devient hantée par des enregistrements terrifiants qui lui sont mystérieusement envoyés. (Movies, Horror) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Gourou
programme.desc: Matt est un coach en développement personnel. Il propose à ses adeptes une catharsis qui électrise les foules autant qu'elle inquiète les autorités. Matt s'engage dans une fuite en avant qui le mènera aux frontières de la folie. (Movies, Drama) - 2026

programme.title: Cinéma - MR-9: Do or Die
programme.desc: Un espion bangladais d'élite s'allie à un agent de la CIA pour une mission périlleuse : démanteler un empire criminel mondial ; ensemble, ils affrontent des dangers extrêmes pour sauver le monde. (Movies, Action) - 2023

programme.title: Cinéma - Golda
programme.desc: Pendant la guerre du Yom Kippour en 1973, le premier ministre israélien Golda Meir doit faire face à des obstacles écrasants, un cabinet sceptique et une relation complexe avec le secrétaire d'État américain Henry Kissinger. (Movies, History) - 2023

programme.title: Cinéma - Diplodocus
programme.desc: Quand son monde est effacé, un petit dinosaure vert voyage à travers les pages d'une bande dessinée pour ramener des couleurs chez lui. (Movies, Animated) - 2024

programme.title: Cinéma - À haut risque
programme.desc: Cole, un brillant voleur expert en technologie, parcourt la ville au volant de sa voiture, utilisant ses compétences hautement spécialisées pour commettre des cambriolages sophistiqués depuis son ordinateur portable. (Movies, Thriller) - 2026

programme.title: Cinéma - Simplement Savvy
programme.desc: Savvy reprend sa vie en main et apporte des changements dans sa cuisine et sa carrière. Isaiah, entrepreneur charmant, devient l'ingrédient secret de sa vie amoureuse. (Movies, Romance) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Dracula
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un prince du 15e siècle renie Dieu après la mort de sa femme, il hérite d'une malédiction éternelle et devient Dracula. Condamné à errer au fil des siècles, il défie le destin et la mort dans l'espoir de retrouver son amour perdu. (Movies, Horror) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - L'amour ouf
programme.desc: Dans les années 80, en France, Jackie et Clotaire grandissent entre l'école et le port. Leurs destins se croisent et c'est l'amour fou. La vie s'efforcera de les séparer, mais ces deux-là sont comme les deux ventricules d'un cœur. (Movies, Comedy) - 2024

programme.title: Cinéma - Trajectoire
programme.desc: Un astronaute peine à garder son emprise sur la réalité lors d'une mission qui pourrait s'avérer mortelle sur Titan, la lune de Saturne. (Movies, Sci-Fi) - 2024

programme.title: Cinéma - Marche ou crève
programme.desc: Le jeune Garraty va concourir pour. (Movies, Thriller) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - L'étage interdit
programme.desc: Max commence à travailler dans une maison de retraite et découvre que les résidents et le personnel cachent de sombres secrets. Son travail lui fait découvrir des dangers inattendus. (Movies, Horror) - 2025

programme.title: Pillion
programme.desc: Un homme timide voit sa vie bouleversée lorsqu'un motard énigmatique et irrésistible le prend sous son aile et l'entraîne dans une relation de domination qui le dépasse complètement. (Movies, Romance) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Opus
programme.desc: Une jeune autrice est invitée à se rendre à la résidence recluse d'une vedette de la pop ayant mystérieusement disparu 30 ans auparavant. (Movies, Horror) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Sifflet maudit
programme.desc: Un groupe d'élèves inadaptés découvre par hasard un objet maudit, un ancien Sifflet de la Mort aztèque. Ils découvrent qu'en soufflant dans le sifflet, le son terrifiant qu'il émet fera venir leurs morts futures pour les traquer. (Movies, Horror) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Fanon
programme.desc: Les méthodes progressistes de Fanon à l'hôpital de Blida suscitent la controverse. Ses soins empreints d'humanité irritent le personnel. Recruté par Ramdane du FLN, il rejoint avec sa femme Josie la lutte pour l'indépendance de l'Algérie. (Movies, Biography) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Insaisissable 3
programme.desc: Les Cavaliers sont de retour pour le braquage le plus impressionnant jamais imaginé. Accompagnés d'un groupe de jeunes magiciens qui espèrent suivre leur trace, ils vont devoir repousser les limites de l'illusion. (Movies, Comedy) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Romance imprévue
programme.desc: Un écrivain rencontre par hasard l'amour de sa vie et découvre que la jeune femme est fiancée ; malgré les exhortations de son meilleur ami hypocondriaque, il met bientôt son monde sens dessus dessous dans une quête désespérée. (Movies, Romance) - 2024

programme.title: Cinéma - Pédalo
programme.desc: Deux couples d'amis partent dans un tout-inclus à Cuba pour fuir l'hiver. Très vite, Claudia, la conjointe de Sébastien, plonge un peu trop dans l'alcool. Tandis que Bruno réalise que d'inviter Mia n'était peut-être pas l'idée du siècle. (Movies, Comedy) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - La malédiction: le commencement
programme.desc: Après avoir été envoyée à Rome pour entrer au service de l'Église, une jeune Américaine se retrouve bientôt confrontée à des forces obscures qui l'amènent à remettre en question sa propre foi. (Movies, Horror) - 2024

programme.title: Cinéma - Fanon
programme.desc: Les méthodes progressistes de Fanon à l'hôpital de Blida suscitent la controverse. Ses soins empreints d'humanité irritent le personnel. Recruté par Ramdane du FLN, il rejoint avec sa femme Josie la lutte pour l'indépendance de l'Algérie. (Movies, Biography) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Est-ce que ça fonctionne?
programme.desc: Alex doit affronter les doutes de la cinquantaine et la menace d'un divorce imminent. À la recherche d'un nouveau souffle, il se lance dans le milieu du stand-up, tandis que Tess remet en question les sacrifices qu'elle a faits pour leur famille. (Movies, Comedy, Drama) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Par amour
programme.desc: Sarah et Antoine, débordés par le travail et leurs deux enfants, sont au bord de la rupture ; leur fils aîné confie à sa mère qu'il entend des voix ; Sarah décide de soutenir son fils coûte que coûte ; jusqu'où sera-t-elle prête à aller, par amour ? (Movies, Drama) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Nouvelle vague
programme.desc: Paris, 1959. Un réalisateur inconnu, un producteur aventureux, un budget dérisoire, une équipe minuscule, et le projet fou de tourner un premier film en 20 jours avec un embryon de scénario sur un voyou en cavale et sa petite amie. (Movies, Comedy) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Héron bleu
programme.desc: À la fin des années 1990, Sasha, huit ans, et sa famille d'immigrants hongrois déménagent dans une nouvelle maison sur l'île de Vancouver. Leur nouveau départ est interrompu par un comportement de plus en plus dangereux de la part de l'enfant aîné. (Movies, Drama) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - 5 septembre
programme.desc: En 1972, des journalistes sont installés à Munich à l'occasion des Jeux olympiques. Lorsqu'ils apprennent que des terroristes ont pris en otage des membres de l'équipe d'Israël, ils mettent tout en œuvre pour offrir une couverture de l'événement. (Movies, Thriller) - 2024

programme.title: Cinéma - Ballerine
programme.desc: Une assassine formée selon les traditions de l'organisation Ruska Roma part en quête de vengeance après la mort de son père. (Movies, Action) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Virage fatal
programme.desc: Josh, un père de famille sans histoire, se retrouve entraîné à sauver les victimes d'accidents de voiture à un coin de rue dangereux devant chez lui. Cependant, son obsession grandissante le pousse à négliger sa femme et son fils. (Movies, Thriller) - 2024

programme.title: Cinéma - Pris au piège
programme.desc: En rentrant chez lui, Hank Thompson tombe sur son voisin Russ. Ce dernier lui demande de prendre soin de son chat pendant son absence. Au fil des jours, Hank est témoin du passage d'individus louches qui se mettent à fréquenter son immeuble. (Movies, Thriller) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Bonne fortune
programme.desc: Gabriel, un ange gardien, souhaite avoir de plus grandes responsabilités afin d'aider les âmes perdues. Il est témoin des difficultés vécues par Arj. À l'opposé, Jeff mène une existence oisive et luxueuse. Gabriel décide d'intervenir auprès d'eux. (Movies, Comedy) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - L'anniversaire
programme.desc: L'universitaire Ellen se rend compte que Liz, l'amoureuse de son fils Josh, est une étudiante qui a été congédiée quelques années auparavant de sa faculté à cause de sa participation active dans un mouvement ultraradical. (Movies, Thriller) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Springsteen: délivrez-moi de nulle part
programme.desc: À l'aube d'une notoriété mondiale, le rockeur du New Jersey Bruce Springsteen lutte pour concilier les pressions du succès avec les fantômes de son passé alors qu'il enregistre l'album. (Movies, Biography) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Les Furies
programme.desc: Pour venger leur temps de glace perdu, une joueuse de hockey impulsive et une impitoyable octogénaire, ancienne championne de derby, ont un plan: recruter les laissées pour compte de la ville et mettre sur pied une équipe de roller derby clandestine. (Movies, Comedy) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - L'amateur
programme.desc: Employé comme décodeur à la CIA, un homme voit sa vie basculer lorsque son épouse est tuée lors d'un acte terroriste. En quête de justice, il se heurte toutefois à la bureaucratie de ses supérieurs. (Movies, Action) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Les tourmentés
programme.desc: Un vétéran sans-abri souffrant de stress post-traumatique se voit offrir de l'argent par son ancien sergent pour être chassé comme gibier ; s'il survit un mois, il garde l'argent ; la chasse commence dans six mois, à l'étranger. (Movies, Drama) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Le fils du charpentier
programme.desc: Dans un village reculé d'Égypte, un charpentier, sa femme et leur fils Jésus deviennent la cible de forces surnaturelles, déclenchant une lutte spirituelle. (Movies, Horror) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Ma fille tu seras libre
programme.desc: Afghanistan, printemps 2002. Forcée de se marier à un homme de 65 ans, Zarmina, 15 ans, fuit son pays pour Montréal, mais sa liberté a un prix : sa fille devra un jour épouser son cousin resté à Kaboul. Quinze ans plus tard, le pacte refait surface. (Movies, Drama) - 2026

programme.title: Cinéma - La mère et l'ours
programme.desc: Après que Sumi, 26 ans, a été victime d'un accident, sa mère autoritaire, Sara, arrive de Séoul pour être aux côtés de sa fille, désormais dans le coma. (Movies, Drama) - 2024

programme.title: Cinéma - Immaculée
programme.desc: Cecilia, une jeune femme de foi américaine, est accueillie dans un couvent isolé de la campagne italienne, où elle se voit offrir un nouveau rôle. Cecilia comprend rapidement que sa nouvelle demeure abrite un sinistre secret. (Movies, Horror) - 2024

programme.title: Cinéma - Shadow Force
programme.desc: Kyrah et Isaac étaient les chefs d'une unité spéciale internationale nommée Shadow Force. Brisant les règles, ils tombent amoureux et, pour protéger leur fils, ils disparaissent dans la clandestinité. (Movies, Action) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Dracula
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un prince du 15e siècle renie Dieu après la mort de sa femme, il hérite d'une malédiction éternelle et devient Dracula. Condamné à errer au fil des siècles, il défie le destin et la mort dans l'espoir de retrouver son amour perdu. (Movies, Horror) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Monsieur Aznavour
programme.desc: Fils de réfugiés, pauvre, à la voix voilée, on disait de lui qu'il n'avait rien pour réussir. À force de travail, de persévérance et de volonté, Charles Aznavour est devenu un monument de la chanson et un symbole de la culture française. (Movies, Biography) - 2024

programme.title: Cinéma - Air: courtiser une légende
programme.desc: Sonny Vaccaro et Nike poursuivent la recrue de basket-ball Michael Jordan, créant un partenariat qui révolutionne le monde du sport et de la culture contemporaine. (Movies, Drama) - 2023

programme.title: Cinéma - Hola Frida
programme.desc: C'est l'histoire d'une petite fille différente. Son monde, c'est Coyoacán au Mexique. Pétillante, vibrante, tout l'intéresse. Et lorsque les épreuves se présentent, elle leur fait face grâce à un imaginaire débordant. (Movies, Animated) - 2024

programme.title: Cinéma - Dalloway
programme.desc: Clarissa, romancière en résidence, s'appuie sur Dalloway, son IA confidente. Mais l'aide se fait intrusion. Entre l'IA et les paranos, elle enquête : menace réelle ou délire créatif ? (Movies, Thriller) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Cap Farewell
programme.desc: À sa sortie de prison, Toni tente de reprendre sa vie en main et de se rapprocher de sa fille, élevée par sa grand-mère. Mais son passé la rattrape lorsqu'elle découvre les activités illégales de son entourage. (Movies, Drama) - 2026

programme.title: Cinéma - On vous croit
programme.desc: Aujourd'hui, Alice se retrouve devant un juge et n'a pas le droit à l'erreur. Elle doit défendre ses enfants, dont la garde est remise en cause. Pourra-t-elle les protéger de leur père avant qu'il ne soit trop tard? (Movies, Drama) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Nirvanna le band la série le film
programme.desc: Lorsque leur plan pour réserver un spectacle tourne mal, Matt et Jay voyagent accidentellement dans le passé jusqu'en 2008. (Movies, Comedy) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Barcelone, mon amour
programme.desc: Erica, traductrice américaine, remanie en secret un roman qui se déroule à Barcelone. Tout bascule pour elle lorsque Nico, le propriétaire d'une librairie, invite Anna, l'autrice officiellement créditée, pour une séance de dédicaces en ville. (Movies, Romance) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Barcelone, pour toujours
programme.desc: De retour à Barcelone pour célébrer les fiançailles d'Erica avec Nico, Anna fait la rencontre d'un fermier charmant et se retrouve, par un concours de circonstances, fiancée afin de préserver l'héritage familial de celui-ci. (Movies, Romance) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Comment faire un malheur
programme.desc: En prison et sur le point d'être exécuté, Becket Redfellow raconte son histoire au prêtre venu le confesser. (Movies, Comedy) - 2026

programme.title: Cinéma - MaXXXine
programme.desc: À Los Angeles dans les années 80, Maxine Minx obtient finalement le rôle tant espéré, mais lorsqu'un mystérieux tueur traque les starlettes de Hollywood, des indices sanglants menacent de dévoiler le sombre passé de Maxine. (Movies, Horror) - 2024

programme.title: Cinéma - Ce qu'elles disent
programme.desc: Les femmes d'une colonie religieuse isolée luttent pour se réconcilier avec leur foi après une série d'agressions sexuelles. (Movies, Drama) - 2022

programme.title: Cinéma - Depuis le temps qu'on rêvait
programme.desc: Entraîneur de natation passionné et père dévoué, Gideon fait face à la réalité tumultueuse de l'sans-abrisme invisible lorsqu'il est contraint de vivre dans sa camionnette. (Movies, Drama) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Obsession
programme.desc: Des blessures enfouies depuis longtemps remontent à la surface lorsque l'emblématique vedette de la pop Mother Mary se réunit avec sa meilleure amie et ancienne créatrice de costumes, Sam Anselm, à la veille de son retour. (Movies, Thriller) - 2026

programme.title: Cinéma - L'étranger
programme.desc: Alger, 1938. Meursault, un jeune homme d'une trentaine d'années, modeste employé, enterre sa mère sans manifester la moindre émotion. Le lendemain, il entame une liaison avec Marie, une collègue de bureau, puis il reprend sa vie de tous les jours. (Movies, Drama) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Le falcon express
programme.desc: Des animaux de compagnie, piégés dans un train, vont devoir déjouer les plans d'Hans, un blaireau rancunier en quête de vengeance. Les animaux peuvent compter sur Falcon, un raton laveur filou et débrouillard, prêt à tout pour les sauver ! (Movies, Animated) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Les délices de l'amour
programme.desc: Les plans de Sari sont chamboulés quand Gabe ouvre une boulangerie à côté du café familial. Une guerre de farces les rapproche. (Movies, Romance) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Super Grand Prix
programme.desc: Edda, une souris avec de grands rêves, saisit sa chance de courir dans le Grand Prix déguisée en son héros, Ed. Elle relève le défi de déjouer le sabotage de son rival et de prouver que même le plus petit coureur peut avoir le plus grand impact. (Movies, Animated) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Le destin de Gemma
programme.desc: Gemma a renoncé aux rencontres jusqu'à ce qu'une voyante lui prédise qu'elle n'est qu'à un dernier rendez-vous désastreux du véritable amour. Sa rencontre avec Nick tourne au chaos, y compris un accident avec un bel inconnu fortuné. (Movies, Romance) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Ici
programme.desc: Une épopée qui raconte les vies de plusieurs familles ayant vécu au même endroit. L'histoire navigue à travers les générations, capturant l'expérience humaine dans sa forme la plus pure. (Movies, Drama) - 2024

programme.title: Cinéma - Déchaîné
programme.desc: Après l'enlèvement de sa fille par un réseau criminel et face à l'inaction de la police, Wang Wei se lance dans une traque implacable pour la retrouver. Son seul allié, Navin, est un journaliste tenace dont la femme a mystérieusement disparu. (Movies, Action) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Bob Marley: One Love
programme.desc: L'auteur-compositeur-interprète jamaïcain Bob Marley surmonte l'adversité pour devenir le musicien de reggae le plus célèbre au monde. (Movies, Biography) - 2024

programme.title: Cinéma - Capitaine
programme.desc: Capitaine éduque sa fille Mia dans l'espoir qu'à l'avenir, elle puisse reprendre son entreprise de pêche. Lorsque Capitaine découvre que Mia a quitté le village, il prend la route afin de la retrouver avant qu'il ne soit trop tard. (Movies, Drama) - 2026

programme.title: Cinéma - Séduire la mort
programme.desc: Rien n'est ce qu'il semble être lorsqu'une aventure d'un soir tordue se transforme en une série de meurtres vicieux perpétrés par un tueur en série. (Movies, Thriller) - 2023

programme.title: Cinéma - Maya & Samar
programme.desc: Maya et Samar racontent l'histoire de deux jeunes femmes issues de cultures opposées dont la brève, mais torride liaison amoureuse met en danger la vie de l'une, tout en propulsant l'autre vers une célébrité instantanée sur les réseaux sociaux. (Movies, Drama) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Le combattant
programme.desc: À la fin des années 1990, Mark Kerr, un champion invaincu de combats d'arts martiaux mixtes dans la ligue UFC, domine la scène mondiale. Mais derrière les victoires se cache une lutte personnelle. (Movies, Biography) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - La femme la plus riche du monde
programme.desc: La femme la plus riche du monde: sa beauté, son intelligence, son pouvoir. Un photographe: son ambition, son insolence, sa folie. Le coup de foudre qui les emporte. Une héritière méfiante qui se bat pour être aimée. Un majordome aux aguets. (Movies, Comedy, Drama) - 2025

programme.title: Cinéma - Perdus en mer
programme.desc: Le voyage de quatre amis vire au cauchemar lorsqu'une violente tempête fait chavirer leur embarcation, les laissant à la dérive en pleine mer. (Movies, Thriller) - 2025

Freed slave Theodore Joadson (Morgan Freeman) wants Cinque and the others exonerated and recruits property lawyer Roger Baldwin (Matthew McConaughey) to help his case. programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

When two silent movie stars', Don Lockwood and Lina Lamont, latest movie is made into a musical a chorus girl is brought in to dub Lina's speaking and singing. Don is on top of the world until Lina finds out. (Musical comedy) - 1952

programme.title: To Be or Not to Be
programme.desc: Acting couple Joseph (Jack Benny) and Maria Tura (Carole Lombard) are managing a theatrical troupe when the Nazis invade Poland. Maria is having an affair with Lieutenant Sobinski (Robert Stack), who suspects Professor Siletsky (Stanley Ridges) is a Nazi spy. With Siletsky in possession of a list of members of the Polish resistance, the Turas' company takes action. Using their skill for impersonation, Joseph and company must confuse the Nazis and stop Siletsky from handing over the list. (Comedy) - 1942

programme.title: Night Song
programme.desc: At a nightclub, pianist Dan Evans (Dana Andrews) impresses socialite Cathy Mallory (Merle Oberon) with his unique compositions. Learning from Dan's best friend, bandleader Chick Morgan (Hoagy Carmichael), that the proud and embittered Dan is blind, Cathy nevertheless tries to befriend him, only to be rebuffed. The single-minded Cathy then arranges with Chick to meet Dan, pretending to be blind and poor, then secretly arranges a composition contest hoping that Dan will win money for an operation. (Drama) - 1947

programme.title: Picnic at Hanging Rock
programme.desc: In the early 1900s, Miranda (Anne Lambert) attends a girls boarding school in Australia. One Valentine's Day, the school's typically strict headmistress (Rachel Roberts) treats the girls to a picnic field trip to an unusual but scenic volcanic formation called Hanging Rock. Despite rules against it, Miranda and several other girls venture off. It's not until the end of the day that the faculty realizes the girls and one of the teachers (Vivean Gray) have disappeared mysteriously. (Mystery, Drama) - 1975

programme.title: Witness for the Prosecution
programme.desc: The affable Leonard Vole (Tyrone Power) is being tried for the murder of a wealthy woman, and legendary lawyer Sir Wilfrid Robarts (Charles Laughton) has chosen to represent him. Unfortunately, Leonard's alibi depends on the testimony of his callous wife, Christine (Marlene Dietrich) -- who, after the discovery of a legal loophole, makes the shocking decision to appear in court against him. To Sir Wilfrid's surprise, this is only the first in a series of puzzling revelations and reversals. (Crime drama, Mystery) - 1957

programme.title: Stage Fright
programme.desc: An English drama student (Jane Wyman) and her father help a young man (Richard Todd) accused of killing an actress's (Marlene Dietrich) husband. - 1950

programme.title: The Unknown
programme.desc: A fugitive posing as a circus performer goes to extreme lengths to win the heart of his lovely assistant. - 1927

programme.title: Day of Wrath
programme.desc: In 17th-century Denmark, a pastor's (Thorkild Roose) second wife (Lisbeth Movin) is accused of being a witch after falling in love with her stepson. - 1943

programme.title: Ordet
programme.desc: Two sons of a Christian (Henrik Malberg) doubt their faith, while another (Preben Lerdorff Rye) believes he is Jesus Christ. - 1955

programme.title: Gold Rush Maisie
programme.desc: Maisie hears about a gold rush just outside a town, and decides to go into business with a family of poor prospectors and a crotchety ranch owner who may be unknowingly sitting on a valuable vein of gold. - 1940

programme.title: Maisie Gets Her Man
programme.desc: Maisie (Ann Sothern) falls on hard times and works at several odd jobs before she meets aspiring comedian Hap (Red Skelton). - 1942

programme.title: The Barbarian
programme.desc: An Egyptian-American woman (Myrna Loy) runs around Cairo with a desert charmer (Ramon Novarro) who turns out to be a prince. - 1933

programme.title: When Ladies Meet
programme.desc: The wife (Ann Harding) of a publisher meets his girlfriend (Myrna Loy), who does not know he's married. - 1933

programme.title: Penthouse
programme.desc: A gangster, his lawyer (Warner Baxter) and an underworld mistress (Myrna Loy) topple a rival gangster together. - 1933

programme.title: Night Flight
programme.desc: Pilots risk their lives by flying in dangerous weather through the Andes Mountains to deliver medicine to Rio de Janeiro. - 1933

programme.title: The Prizefighter and the Lady
programme.desc: Inspired by a gangster's girlfriend (Myrna Loy), a heavyweight contender (Max Baer) takes on the champ (Primo Carnera). - 1933

programme.title: Men in White
programme.desc: A socialite (Myrna Loy) lures a young surgeon (Clark Gable) away from his mentor (Jean Hersholt) and research work. - 1934

programme.title: Stamboul Quest
programme.desc: A U.S. medical student (George Brent) falls for a German spy (Myrna Loy) and follows her to World War I Turkey. - 1934

programme.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
programme.desc: Fred, Al and Homer are three World War II veterans facing difficulties as they re-enter civilian life. Fred (Dana Andrews) is a war hero who, unable to compete with more highly skilled workers, has to return to his low-wage soda jerk job. Bank executive Al (Fredric March) gets into trouble for offering favorable loans to veterans. After losing both hands in the war, Homer (Harold Russell) returns to his loving fiancée, but must struggle to adjust. (Drama) - 1946

programme.title: The Red Pony
programme.desc: In the Salinas Valley of California, young Tom Tiflin lives on his family's ranch with his parents, Fred and Alice, who are constantly at odds, and with his rambling grandfather. Capturing Tom's admiration, however, is the hired ranch hand, Billy Buck, a venerable horse expert. When his father gives him a pony as a gift, Tom learns the importance of responsibility, but also has to face the pain of loss. (Adventure) - 1949

programme.title: Mr. Blandings Builds His Dream House
programme.desc: When advertising executive Jim Blandings discovers his wife's plan to redecorate their New York apartment, he counters with a proposal that they move to Connecticut. She agrees, and the two are soon conned into buying a house that turns out to be a complete nightmare. Construction and repair bills accumulate quickly, and Jim worries that their future hangs in the balance unless he can come up with a catchy new jingle that will sell ham. (Comedy drama) - 1948

programme.title: The Bachelor and the Bobby-Soxer
programme.desc: Artist playboy Dickie Nugent (Cary Grant) appears before beautiful judge Margaret Turner (Myrna Loy) for fighting at a nightclub, and charms her into dismissing the charge. That same day, Dickie happens to lecture at a high school, where Margaret's teenage sister, Susan (Shirley Temple), falls head-over-heels for him. Things get complicated when Susan sneaks away and is found in Dickie's apartment, and downright zany when he is court ordered to date the teen as a way of easing her attraction. (Comedy) - 1947

programme.title: Third Finger, Left Hand
programme.desc: Uninterested in an office romance, successful fashion journalist Margot Sherwood Merrick (Myrna Loy) goes to great lengths to conceal the fact that she's single. To ward off potential beaus, including painter Jeff Thompson (Melvyn Douglas), she wears a fake wedding ring and tells everyone she already has a husband. When Jeff realizes that Margot doesn't have a spouse, he decides to make her pay for her deception by posing as her husband, leading to a comical rivalry and a surprising romance. (Comedy) - 1940

programme.title: So Goes My Love
programme.desc: Eccentric British inventor Hiram Maxim (Don Ameche) and his bride (Myrna Loy) raise a son (Bobby Driscoll) in late-1800s Brooklyn. (Romantic comedy) - 1946

programme.title: A Successful Calamity
programme.desc: After a year away in Europe, successful financier Henry Wilton (George Arliss) is finally returning home to his wife, Emmy (Mary Astor), daughter Peggy (Evalyn Knapp) and son Eddie, only to discover their lifestyle leaves them much too busy to spend any time together as a family. In a ploy to keep everyone together, Wilton lies about his wealth and announces he's financially ruined. As expected, his family rallies to support his supposed losses, but how long can he keep the charade up? (Comedy) - 1932

programme.title: Turn Back the Clock
programme.desc: A cigar-store keeper (Lee Tracy) dreams of what his life would have been like with power, prestige and a rich wife. (Comedy drama) - 1933

programme.title: The Millionaire
programme.desc: Growing bored with life as a retiree, millionaire James Alden (George Arliss) secretly invests in an unprofitable gas station to amuse himself. Disguising himself and using the alias "Charles Miller," James begins a partnership with a young bootstrapper named Bill Merrick (David Manners). Complications arise when James' spoiled daughter, Barbara (Evalyn Knapp), becomes a regular customer and competition from a neighboring gas station threatens to ruin the business. (Comedy) - 1931

programme.title: Tycoon
programme.desc: American engineer Johnny Munroe (John Wayne) is hired by South American tycoon Frederick Alexander (Cedric Hardwicke) to bore a tunnel for a new railroad in the Andes Mountains. On the job, he falls for Alexander's beautiful daughter, Maura (Laraine Day). Facing dangerous conditions and serious design challenges, Munroe struggles to complete the job he was hired to do, while simultaneously struggling to convince his skeptical, overprotective employer that he is a worthy suitor for Maura. (Drama) - 1947

programme.title: Silver Dollar
programme.desc: Yates Martin (Edward G. Robinson) and his wife, Sarah (Aline MacMahon), are struggling to make ends meet as owners of a grocery store in late 19th-century Colorado. When Martin's silver mine strikes it rich, he begins to live the high life, moving to a huge mansion and running for public office. His grandiose ways alienate his wife, however, so he takes up with Lily (Bebe Daniels). Then Martin begins dreaming of running for national office, unaware that his fate will change once again. (Biography) - 1933

programme.title: The World Changes
programme.desc: A young Midwesterner (Paul Muni) becomes a meat tycoon with a socialite wife (Mary Astor). (Drama) - 1933

programme.title: Boom Town
programme.desc: Two rogue Texas oil men, Big John McMasters (Clark Gable) and Square John Sand (Spencer Tracy), drill oil wells in fields where there is no known oil. These wildcatters team up with a local drilling equipment owner, Luther Aldrich (Frank Morgan), and strike it rich -- but the ups and downs of the oil business, the whims of South American politics, and the love of Elizabeth Betsy Bartlett (Claudette Colbert) threaten to tear the two friends apart. (Adventure) - 1940

programme.title: The Enchanted Cottage
programme.desc: Disfigured from wounds suffered in war, pilot Oliver Bradford (Robert Young) runs away in shame from his beautiful fiancée (Hillary Brooke) and his mother (Spring Byington). Renting a cottage from the kind-hearted Mrs. Minnett (Mildred Natwick), Oliver meets the plain-looking but gentle housekeeper Laura Pennington (Dorothy McGuire). As the veteran and the maid begin to learn more about one another, they see past their outer imperfections to discover that true beauty lies within. (Romance) - 1945

programme.title: Desire Me
programme.desc: Soldiers Paul Aubert and Jean Renaud attempt to make their escape from a Nazi prison camp, but only Jean makes it out alive. When Jean is dispatched to deliver the sad news to Paul's wife, Marise, he begins a budding romance with the recently widowed woman. Then Paul, injured but still very much alive, sends word that he is coming to reunite with his wife, putting a damper on Jean's plans to start a new life with Marise. (Romance) - 1947

programme.title: The Great Lie
programme.desc: After her long-time boyfriend, pilot Pete Van Allen (George Brent), marries fiery concert pianist Sandra Kovak (Mary Astor) while drunk, Maggie Patterson (Bette Davis) is heartbroken. Pete learns the marriage is illegal, yet dutifully offers to remarry Sandra. But when she refuses to alter a performance date to do so, Pete returns to Maggie and marries her. Soon after, Pete goes missing on a flight -- and when Maggie learns Sandra is carrying Pete's baby, she makes the pianist a shocking offer. (Romance) - 1941

programme.title: Random Harvest
programme.desc: A veteran of World War I, Charles Rainier (Ronald Colman) has lost all memory of his life before the war. Left to wander, Rainier meets a showgirl, Paula (Greer Garson), with whom he falls in love. Rainier and Paula are soon happily married, but when Rainier travels out of town, a car hits him -- erasing the memories of his life with Paula, but restoring those of his life before the war. While he returns to his previous life, Paula tries to find a way to be reunited with her husband. (Drama) - 1942

programme.title: I Know Where I'm Going!
programme.desc: Plucky Englishwoman Joan Webster travels to the remote islands of the Scottish Hebrides in order to marry a wealthy industrialist. Trapped by inclement weather on the Isle of Mull and unable to continue to her destination, Joan finds herself charmed by the straightforward, no-nonsense islanders around her, and becomes increasingly attracted to naval officer Torquil MacNeil, who holds a secret that may change her life forever. (Romantic comedy) - 1945

programme.title: Dark Victory
programme.desc: Socialite Judith Traherne (Bette Davis) lives a lavish but emotionally empty life. Riding horses is one of her few joys, and her stable master (Humphrey Bogart) is secretly in love with her. Told she has a brain tumor by her doctor, Frederick Steele (George Brent), Judith becomes distraught. After she decides to have surgery to remove the tumor, Judith realizes she is in love with Dr. Steele, but more troubling medical news may sabotage her new relationship, and her second chance at life. (Drama) - 1939

programme.title: They Learned About Women
programme.desc: In this musical, friends Jerry Burke (Gus Van) and Jack Glennon (Joseph T. Schenck) are both baseball players who perform a vaudeville act on the side. Jack attracts the attention of money-hungry Daisy (Mary Doran), who splits up his engagement with sweet Mary (Bessie Love) and his friendship with Jerry. Eventually, Jerry's income is insufficient for Daisy, and she leaves him. Jack, whose team is playing in the World Series, starts dating Mary, but still tries to help his old friend in need. (Musical) - 1930

programme.title: Alibi Ike
programme.desc: With his job on the line, Chicago Cubs manager Cap (William Frawley) needs to turn around his lackluster team fast -- especially since nothing less than the pennant will keep him employed. Fortunately for Cap, rookie pitcher Frank "Ike" Farrell (Joe E. Brown) has just the talent to pull up the fledgling team. However, Ike always has an excuse or a lie handy for every problem -- and the real trouble comes when a group of gamblers looks to fix the Cubs' games, and Ike is their main target. (Comedy) - 1935

programme.title: The Big Leaguer
programme.desc: Young players try out for the founder (Edward G. Robinson) of the New York Giants Florida training camp. (Drama) - 1953

programme.title: The Pride of the Yankees
programme.desc: This moving biographical drama follows the life of revered baseball player Lou Gehrig (Gary Cooper). Championed by sportswriter Sam Blake (Walter Brennan), Gehrig eventually gets recruited by the New York Yankees, joining a team of heavy hitters that includes the legendary Babe Ruth. When Gehrig marries his spirited sweetheart, Eleanor (Teresa Wright), things look up for him, but he is soon sidelined by a terrible illness that he bravely tries to battle. (Biography) - 1942

programme.title: The Winning Team
programme.desc: In 1908 Nebraska, young Grover Cleveland Alex Alexander (Ronald Reagan) saves to buy a farm for himself and his fiancée, Aimee (Doris Day), but also longs to realize his dream of playing baseball. His pitching skills win him a position on an Illinois team, but an injury almost ruins his chance. Once he recovers, he and Aimee wed, and he returns to baseball and begins an increasingly successful career -- until he's diagnosed with epilepsy, which he struggles to hide from the public and Aimee. (Romance, Biography, Docudrama) - 1952

programme.title: Angels in the Outfield
programme.desc: A newspaper reporter, Jennifer Paige (Janet Leigh), is investigating the Pittsburgh Pirates' losing streak. The team is led by manager Guffy McGovern (Paul Douglas), whose swearing and fighting hinder his team's progress. Meanwhile, an orphan named Bridget White (Donna Corcoran) has been praying for the team, and her pleas are answered by an angelic voice. The angel begins urging Guffy to be kinder in return for helping the Pirates win, but the playoffs test the manager's temper. (Children, Comedy) - 1951

programme.title: Take Me Out to the Ball Game
programme.desc: Despite being key players for the Wolves, baseball players Dennis Ryan (Frank Sinatra) and Eddie O'Brien (Gene Kelly) harbor a passion for vaudeville. When a local gambler (Edward Arnold) puts a lot of money on the Wolves to lose a big game, he tries to win the bet by offering Eddie the lead role in a newly produced show. Though Eddie is tempted to accept, he risks incurring the wrath of both Dennis and the team's owner (Esther Williams), who just happens to be his girlfriend. (Musical comedy) - 1949

programme.title: The Jackie Robinson Story
programme.desc: After a successful baseball career in college and as a coach in the military, Jackie Robinson (playing himself) attracts the attention of Major League Baseball's Branch Rickey (Minor Watson). Rickey wants Robinson to play in the minor leagues, believing he can become the first player to break the color barrier and play in the majors. The only catch: He is forbidden from defending himself against racial bigotry. Supported by his wife (Ruby Dee), Robinson is steadfast in his determination to win. (Biography) - 1950

programme.title: Sergeant Rutledge
programme.desc: At a U.S. Army fort in the Arizona Territory in 1881, an officer is murdered, and his beautiful young daughter is beaten, raped and strangled. Army lawyer Tom Cantrell (Jeffrey Hunter) defends the accused, African-American sergeant Braxton Rutledge (Woody Strode), a soldier who had once been under his command. Under questioning by Cantrell and the prosecutor (Carleton Young), multiple witnesses piece together the truth of what happened at the fort that day. (Western) - 1960

programme.title: The Harlem Globetrotters
programme.desc: An athlete drops out of college to join Abe Saperstein's basketball team. (Drama) - 1951

programme.title: The Horse Soldiers
programme.desc: Set during the Civil War, Colonel John Marlowe leads a Union Calvary brigade on a mission behind Confederate lines to destroy enemy railroads and supplies. The colonel is confronted with numerous challenges before reaching Union held Baton Rouge. (Action) - 1959

programme.title: The Fish That Saved Pittsburgh
programme.desc: An astrologer (Stockard Channing) helps a water boy (James Bond III) match players to his basketball team's star (Julius Erving), whose sign is Pisces. (Comedy) - 1979

programme.title: MGM Parade Show
programme.desc: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films. (Special, Drama) - 2005-12-09

programme.title: Law of the Tropics
programme.desc: A nightclub singer (Constance Bennett) marries a jilted rubber salesman (Jeffrey Lynn) in the Amazon. (Romance) - 1941

programme.title: After Office Hours
programme.desc: A managing editor (Clark Gable) sends a socialite reporter (Constance Bennett) to spy on her boyfriend, mixed up in murder. (Crime drama) - 1935

programme.title: What Price Hollywood?
programme.desc: When pretty waitress and Hollywood hopeful Mary Evans (Constance Bennett) serves drinks to famous director Max Carey (Lowell Sherman), a Tinseltown cliché becomes reality, and he offers her a bit part in his new film. Almost blowing her chance due to nerves and inexperience, Mary finally clicks as an actress and becomes an overnight star. But after she marries a polo player (Neil Hamilton) who has no interest in the movie business, Max feels betrayed and descends into an alcoholic depression. (Drama) - 1932

programme.title: Bed of Roses
programme.desc: Two wayward women (Constance Bennett, Pert Kelton) go down the Mississippi by steamboat, looking for men to fleece. (Drama) - 1933

programme.title: Wild Bill Hickok Rides
programme.desc: Wild Bill (Bruce Cabot) and a casino queen (Constance Bennett) thwart a river-basin land-grabber (Warren William) working for Chicago big shots. (Western) - 1942

programme.title: The Unsuspected
programme.desc: A woman is found dead in what seems to be a suicide at the estate of radio host Victor Grandison (Claude Rains). Grandison, who reads chilling murder mysteries on the radio, is at first suspected of murder but is quickly able to clear his name with the police. Then mysterious Steven Francis Howard (Michael North) arrives, claiming to be the husband of Grandison's niece -- who was thought dead in a shipwreck. Howard begins looking into the suicide and soon brings to light new evidence. (Crime drama) - 1947

programme.title: Smart Woman
programme.desc: Lawyer Paula Rogers (Constance Bennett) is appointed to prosecute corrupt district attorney Bradley Wayne (Otto Kruger) for obstruction of justice in an effort to find a missing witness being held by Wayne's partner, racketeer Frank McCoy (Barry Sullivan). Blackmailed by McCoy into defending the criminals instead, Paula falls in love with prosecutor Robert Larrimore (Brian Aherne). As the two grow closer, they join professional forces to indict Wayne and McCoy. (Drama) - 1948

programme.title: Topper
programme.desc: George (Cary Grant) and Marion Kerby (Constance Bennett) are a young, happy-go-lucky couple who love to party. But after a car accident kills them both, they discover that they haven't done enough good deeds to earn a trip to heaven. To remedy this problem, they decide to help their old uptight boss, Cosmo Topper (Roland Young), live a little. While Topper begins to take their ghostly advice and enjoy life for a change, his controlling wife finds her husband's laid-back behavior infuriating. (Comedy) - 1937

programme.title: Topper Takes a Trip
programme.desc: To gain entry to heaven, ghost Marion Kirby (Constance Bennett) has to do some good on earth. That means reuniting a divorcing couple, Cosmo (Roland Young) and Clara Topper (Billie Burke). To be fair, Marion played a part in their troubles: Clara mistakenly thought Marion was Cosmo's mistress. Making peace between the pair will mean accompanying Cosmo on a trip to the French Riviera and employing plenty of otherworldly tricks -- with the help of a canine spirit named Skippy. (Comedy) - 1939

programme.title: The Snake Pit
programme.desc: In this psychological drama, Virginia Cunningham is confused upon finding herself in a mental hospital, with no memory of her arrival at the institution. Tormented by delusions and unable to even recognize her husband, Robert, she is treated by Dr. Mark Kik, who is determined to get to the root of her mental illness. As her treatment progresses, flashbacks depict events in Virginia's life that may have contributed to her instability. (Drama) - 1948

programme.desc: Une famille en pleines vacances tropicales découvre que la plage sur laquelle elle s'est posée pour quelques heures fait rapidement vieillir les membres, résumant leur vie entière en l'espace d'une seule journée. (Movies, Horror) - 2021

programme.title: Cinéma - Cible 22
programme.desc: Un agent de la CIA et une équipe paramilitaire doivent escorter un atout de renseignement étranger 22 mille à travers l'Asie du Sud-Est. Ils se retrouvent bientôt dans une course contre-la-montre. (Movies, Action) - 2018

programme.desc: Julie Houle et Sébastien Benoît accueillent six participants, qui sont assurés de gagner un lot et courent la chance de remporter le gros lot ; chaque joute comprend le jeu des roulettes, le jeu des portes et le célèbre jeu de l'œuf ou l'enveloppe. (Game Shows)

programme.title: Chanteurs masqués - Comédie musicale

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. programme.title: Tunnel to Towers: Steel Across America Tour
Tunnel to Towers: Steel Across America Tour
Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered. (Comedy drama, Medical) - 2026-01-04

programme.desc: Clarence is a spirited boy who sees the best in everything. His unique perspective on life transforms even a mundane situation into one that is interesting or fun. Epic dirt fights, awkward crushes and secret tree forts are all par for the course for the youngster, who shares his experiences with his family and friends. programme.desc: Al final de la década de los ochentas, en el negocio ilícito más lucrativo de la época, "el oro blanco", las rutas de las Bahamas y Florida, ya no son tan viables para el transporte de la cocaína; la persecución de los miembros de los carteles colombianos y su guerra entre ellos mismos se intensifica, generando que estos bandidos sean extraditados, encarcelados en su país o asesinados. Algunos son condenados al encierro voluntario, escondidos en algún rincón para evitar su captura, por cuenta de las fuerzas armadas o de sus enemigos. El negocio cambia y es cuando aparece Amado Carrillo Fuentes "El Señor de los Cielos" que en forma muy discreta se dedica al transporte del producto que proveen los narcotraficantes colombianos restantes, convirtiéndose en el narcotraficante más poderoso de los cuatro carteles que operan en México: el de Juárez, el del Golfo, el de Sinaloa y el de Tijuana. Su historia se devela en este drama cargado de acción y giros inusitados.

programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered.

programme.title: Best Medicine
programme.desc: Martin Best is a brilliant surgeon who abruptly leaves his illustrious career in Boston to become the general practitioner in a quaint East Coast fishing village where he spent summers as a child. Unfortunately, Martin's blunt and borderline rude bedside manner rubs the quirky, needy locals the wrong way, and he quickly alienates the town, even though he's all they've got. Although Martin can expertly address any medical ailment or mystery in this idiosyncratic town, he's really just desperate to be left the hell alone. Instead, he keeps getting dragged right smack into the middle of their personal chaos, feuds and fantasies. What the locals don't know is that Martin's terse demeanor masks a debilitating new phobia and deep-seated psychological issues that prevent him from experiencing true intimacy with anyone. But tenacity is the creed of everyone in their small village, and the people who live there may be exactly what the doctor ordered.
